jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Project Coordinator supports the Project Management team by coordinating vendor setup, customer account setup, retail item onboarding, product data management, and the administrative activities required to bring physical consumer products to market.

This role requires prior experience working in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry with physical consumer products sold through retail channels. The ideal candidate has experience supporting products in categories such as beauty, personal care, oral care, wellness, accessories, fashion, or other retail CPG categories.

The Project Coordinator works cross\-functionally with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, Packaging/Creative, and Shipping/Logistics to ensure product information, documentation, samples, item setup, and customer requirements are completed accurately and on time.

This position serves as the department's Vendor \& Item Setup Specialist, while also providing day\-to\-day operational and project coordination support to the Project Management team.

**Responsibilities Product \& Retailer Setup**

* Set up and maintain customer and vendor accounts across retailer, distributor, and customer portals.
* Coordinate new product and item setup requirements for retail customers, distributors, and internal systems.
* Coordinate product information requirements including UPCs, dimensions, case packs, product descriptions, pricing, specifications, packaging information, and other required data.
* Maintain accurate product and item information throughout product launches and ongoing product changes.
* Monitor customer\-specific requirements and ensure submissions are completed accurately and within required timelines

**Cross\-Functional Product Coordination**

* Work cross\-functionally with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, Packaging/Creative, Operations, and Shipping/Logistics to collect and coordinate information required for product launches.
* Follow up with internal departments to obtain product specifications, regulatory information, packaging details, pricing, UPCs, quality documentation, shipping requirements, and other required launch information.
* Coordinate the flow of information between Project Management and internal departments to keep product launches and customer requirements moving forward.
* Support Project Managers with product launch activities, running changes, customer requests, and other project\-related tasks.

**Samples, Shipping \& Logistics**

* Order and coordinate product samples.
* Prepare, package, and ship samples and documents using FedEx and other carriers.
* Maintain accurate records of sample requests, shipments, and related documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous professional experience in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry is required.
* Experience working with physical consumer products that are manufactured and sold through retail channels is required.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with multiple departments is required.
* Experience with product/item setup, retail customer requirements, customer portals, vendor onboarding, or product data management is strongly preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Monday.com, Asana, or similar platforms is preferred.

**Physical \& Position Requirements**

* Full\-time hourly position, onsite.
* Valid driver's license with reliable personal transportation to deliver packages and product samples to local shipping carriers as needed.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple deadlines and changing priorities.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for a proactive, organized, dependable CPG professional who understands how physical consumer products move through a retail environment and enjoys keeping the details behind those products organized and moving forward.

The right person is comfortable working across departments, following up for information, managing deadlines, navigating customer requirements, and jumping between different priorities without losing track of details.

This is not simply an administrative role. We need someone who understands the product lifecycle and retail environment, can communicate effectively with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, and Logistics, and takes ownership of getting things done.

The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who sees what needs to be done, follows through, and anticipates issues. No task is too small or too large; the expectation is that this person will jump in where needed and help keep the Project Management team and product launches moving.

Pay: $28\.85 \- $31\.25 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience working with physical consumer products sold through retail channels?
* Do you have professional experience working with physical consumer packaged goods (CPG) products sold through retail channels?
* Which consumer product categories have you worked in? Beauty / Personal Care

Oral Care, Health / Wellness, Accessories, Fashion / Apparel, Other Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)

* Which functions have you worked cross\-functionally with when coordinating physical consumer products?
* Do you have experience with product or item setup for retailers/customers, including managing product information, specifications, documentation, or customer\-specific requirements?

Experience:

* CPG: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: I

jobs.title: Project Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**



Project Coordinator provides complex administrative support to various members of the project team under the direction of the Office Manager. The Project Coordinator I will be responsible for project oversight and coordination of all its stages from inception to completion by inputting data, tracking, and monitoring control points and program updates. Additional responsibilities include assisting with document management and tracking progress for program estimates.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project \& Workflow Management**


* Intake new leads and jobs, entering all information across platforms to maintain a single, accurate source of data.
* Under the guidance of the Office manager make decisions regarding project assignment to Project Directors to ensure proper project workflow.
* Schedule initial inspections during the initial phone call to ensure parameters are met and provide a single point of contact.
* Update platforms (XactAnalysis, Symbility, AlacNet) to meet program timelines for customer contact and site inspections.
* Upload work authorizations and insurance\-specific documents promptly to facilitate the release of funds.
* Assist with securing third\-party mortgage authorizations, coordinate mortgage inspections, and manage check endorsements.
* Monitor JobTrack to ensure assignments are compliant and input job\-specific milestones.
* Review daily reports and the TPA/Contractor Connection Dashboard to maintain compliance, resolve discrepancies, and notify billing of any disputes.
* Monitor job progress for USAA checks to ensure timely endorsement at final walk\-throughs and verify check amounts against estimates.
* Review completed project files for invoicing, ensuring all estimates, change orders, and close\-out documents are accurate and accounted for.


**Administrative Support**


* Provide high\-level administrative support to Project Directors and the Project Management team.
* Conduct quality checks of purchase orders and administer work authorizations/COSs as needed.
* Prepare job files and organize paperwork accurately using Salesforce.
* Transfer and upload photos into specific files to forward to corporate staff.
* Assist with reconciliation and sending billing reports to accounting staff by monthly deadlines and handle billing exceptions.
* Generate requests to ensure promptness on estimates.
* Attend all appropriate company training and monthly Admin Program meetings.
* Execute administrative support functions and perform special project assistance as needed.


**Qualifications and Experience**


* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in a coordinator or administrative role.
* Construction industry experience preferred.
* Experience working in Salesforce, including generating reports (preferred).

* **TRAVEL \& WORKING CONDITIONS**
* Travel is minimal for this position.
* This position requires sitting for long periods of time and looking at monitors along with typing for extended periods of time.
* This position may require occasional flexibility in schedule to address urgent or time\-sensitive employee relations matters.
* Work is performed in a professional office environment.


  

Compensation: $25\-27/hr

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About McWhirter Steel**

McWhirter Steel is a family owned, Southern California structural steel fabricator and erector serving the construction industry since 1992\. For over three decades McWhirter Steel has built our reputation on quality, craftsmanship, reliability, and unwavering commitment to our clients’ success.

**Position Overview**

The **Project Coordinator** position supports day\-to\-day business operations across the field and administrative teams. This role ensures organizational effectiveness by handling administrative tasks, document control, scheduling, communication, record keeping, and support functions that enable the company to operate efficiently.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple active projects in a fast\-paced construction environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**General Office Administration**

Ø Manage front\-office operations including phones, emails, mail distribution, and visitor coordination

Ø Maintain an organized office environment including conference rooms, supplies, filing, and equipment

Ø Maintain office inventory and reorder supplies as needed

Ø Prepare correspondence, forms, and internal documents for leadership and project teams

Ø Assist with onboarding tasks and coordination for new employees (IT setup, safety orientation packets, HR paperwork)

Ø Support management with scheduling, calendar, and meeting coordination

**Project \& Field Support**

Ø Assist Project Managers with RFIs, submittals, change orders, and tracking logs

Ø Support the Field Superintendent and field leadership with administrative tasks, dispatching support, and documentation

Ø Maintain project binders, drawing logs, and version control

Ø Prepare jobsite packets, installation manuals, and mobilization documents

Ø Coordinate deliveries, trucking schedules, and vendor documentation when needed

Ø Support daily, weekly, and monthly field reporting workflows

Change Management and Cost Control

Ø Assist Project Managers with change order preparation by collecting field documentation, vendor quotations, labor and equipment backup, and other supporting records.

Ø Maintain change order logs, track pricing approval, billing and collection status.

Ø Track project commitments, Purchase Orders, subcontracts, equipment rentals, and vendor costs against project budgets.

Ø Track rental equipment from mobilization through off rent and reconcile rental invoices to help control project equipment costs.

**Document Control \& Compliance**

Ø Maintain accurate filing systems for contracts, POs, submittals, RFIs, safety documents, payroll records, and project files

Ø Ensure all documents comply with internal naming conventions, revision logs, and retention policies

Ø Assist with maintaining company compliance documents such as licenses, insurance certificates, contractor registrations, and vendor forms

Ø Support safety team with maintaining training records, incident reports, and compliance documentation

**Accounting \& Finance Support**

Ø Assist with AP/AR including invoice entry, check processing, receiving paperwork, and billing support

Ø Track job cost documents, receipts, fuel logs, rental equipment invoices, and credit card statements

Ø Support payroll workflows including timesheet collection, union reporting assistance, and filing

Ø Assist with SOV updates, billing packages, lien releases, and preliminary notices as requested

Ø Assist with Purchase Order (PO) requests. Including ordering, receiving, and inventorying of materials and equipment

**Procurement and Vendor Coordination**

Ø Prepare and track Purchase Order requests for project equipment, materials, trucking, cranes, subcontractors, and field support services as directed.

Ø Confirm vendor documentation rates, delivery requirements, invoice, backup, and off rent status.

Ø Communicate professionally with clients, General Contractors, inspectors, vendors, fabricators, and subcontractors while escalating contractual or cost issues to the Project Manager.

**Preconstruction and Estimating Support**

Ø Assist with downloading and organizing plans, specifications, addenda, and bid documents when needed.

Ø Support turnover from estimating to operations by organizing proposal, scope, clarifications, budgets, schedules, and project startup information.

Ø Maintain historical project records and cost information that support future estimating and operational planning.

**Qualifications**

Ø Two to five years of project coordination, project administration, or project engineering experience in commercial construction.

Ø Structural steel, miscellaneous metals, or specialty subcontractor experience is strongly preferred.

Ø Working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project documentation.

Ø Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities.

Ø Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

Ø Experience with Bluebeam, Tekla, Foundation, Microsoft Project, or comparable construction systems is preferred.

Ø Strong written and verbal communication skills with professional follow through.

Ø Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment with project financial and employee information.

Ø Self starter who identifies needs, follows issues through completion, and works effectively with both office and field teams.

**Working Conditions**

Ø Primarily office based in Anaheim, California, with periodic visits to active construction sites.

Ø Standard Monday through Friday schedule with flexibility based on project and business needs.

Ø Jobsite visits may require personal protective equipment and compliance with site specific safety requirements.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Center for Interprofessional Education
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE: Administrative Coordinator**

**DEPARTMENT: Center for Interprofessional Education** **REPORTS TO: Dean, Center for Interprofessional Education****LOCATION: Hybrid Remote (Whittier, California)** **FLSA STATUS: Non\-Exempt, Part\-time (20 hours per week)****RATE OF PAY: $22\.00 to $25\.00 per hour** **SUMMARY:**  

The Center for Interprofessional Education (CIPE) Coordinator plays a key role in advancing the university’s mission of preparing future health professionals for collaborative, team\-based care. This position provides comprehensive coordination for interprofessional education (IPE) activities, the Interprofessional Health Professions (IHP) courses, and the Standardized Patient (SP) program. Working in close partnership with faculty, staff, students, and external collaborators, the coordinator ensures high\-quality programming, seamless operations, and alignment with national best practices, including the Interprofessional Education Collaborative (IPEC) Core Competencies.  

The coordinator reports to the Dean of Interprofessional Education and serves as a central point of contact for IPE activities and SP operations, supporting both the strategic vision of the Center and the day\-to\-day execution of its programs. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Interprofessional Education (IPE) Coordination**

* Coordinate logistics for IPE virtual and on\-ground events, workshops, and activities across all health sciences programs.
* Manage event scheduling, registration, communications, and accurate record\-keeping.
* Serve as the primary contact for faculty and student participants in IPE activities.
* Support assessment efforts, including distribution and collection of pre\-/post\-surveys, attendance tracking, and preparation of evaluation reports.
* Collaborate with program directors and deans to align IPE activities with curricular needs, accreditation standards, and institutional outcomes.
* Provide administrative support for IPE Council and Advisory Board meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, minutes, archiving, and attendance tracking.
* Assist with IHP course coordination, including faculty support, assessment tracking, and course\-related communications.
* Maintain and update the CIPE website and ensure organized archiving of course and event materials.

 **Standardized Patient (SP) Program Coordination**

* Recruit, onboard, and maintain a diverse pool of standardized patients to meet institutional and programmatic needs.
* Schedule and assign SPs for IPE\-related simulations, ensuring adequate coverage and smooth execution of events.
* Track SP participation, training, and performance to ensure consistency and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with institutional policies, FERPA/HIPAA regulations, and confidentiality standards.
* Manage programmatic scheduling needs and calculate budgetary requirements for SP activities.
* Process timely payment for SPs and maintain accurate financial tracking for the SP program.
* Monitor the SP pool, documenting each SP’s strengths, areas for improvement, and training needs.
* Generate annual reports on SP utilization by program to support planning, resource allocation, and accreditation documentation.

 **Collaboration \& Communication**

* Serve as liaison between the CIPE, academic programs, and external partners to ensure alignment and shared goals.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with faculty, students, and SPs to support effective coordination.
* Foster a culture of professionalism, inclusivity, and excellence in all CIPE and SP\-related activities.

 **Evaluation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Collect, analyze, and report data from IPE and SP activities to inform continuous quality improvement.
* Provide regular reports to CIPE leadership and contribute to accreditation documentation.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and growth in IPE and SP programming in alignment with national best practices.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in education, health sciences, public health, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in program coordination, higher education, healthcare, or simulation\-based learning.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with faculty, staff, students, standardized patients, and external partners.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a diverse, fast\-paced academic environment.
* Familiarity with interprofessional education, simulation\-based training, or standardized patient methodology strongly preferred.

**NOTE:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the person assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, and physical demands required of personnel so classified.

 **LOCATION**:  

This position is primarily hybrid. The role requires on\-campus presence at least once per week, with additional in\-person days as needed to support essential functions such as interprofessional events, standardized patient sessions, or team\-based collaboration. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

 **SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND QUALIFICATIONS:**  

**Education and/or Experience**  

Bachelor's degree from four\-year college or university; or 5 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Communication and Language Skills**  

* Ability to read, interpret, and prepare documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to prepare clear, concise, reports and correspondence.
* Ability to speak effectively before groups of faculty, staff, students, and other member

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
SUMMARY  

The Senior Marketing Coordinator develops messages for print and digital forms of marketing, and copyedits content written by self and other members of the Marketing Department team. The incumbent handles daily administrative approval items in customer relationship management (CRM) and timekeeping platforms, and supports marketing campaign/project enhancements and communications for the Marketing department.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  

* Write messages through various content types including print collateral, website content, brochures, publications, product descriptions, press releases, announcements, and other forms of marketing.
* Copyedit content written by self and team members for spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation to ensure accuracy and brand consistency. Work closely with designers and marketing team members to update and amend written content according to feedback.
* Conduct research, monitor marketing trends and support competitive marketing campaigns.
* Maintain marketing database and photo library, and filing systems for paper and electronic documents.
* Fulfill administrative tasks such as sample order entry, and maintaining marketing documents and resource materials related marketing and communication activities.
* Handles daily administrative approval items in Salesforce CRM platform (e.g., sample order entry, Co\-op credit, purchase requisitions, check requests, trip reports, IRAs), and timekeeping platform.
* Provide marketing project and tradeshow support.
* Provide customer service and sales support as needed.
* Exercise judgment to balance priorities and communicate to teams to meet and exceed project deadlines and commitments; keep the marketing team informed of projects and progress.
* Assist with special projects and other job\-related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES  

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


QUALIFICATIONS  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE  

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or Public Relations AND 3 years of related experience, OR equivalent combination of education, training and experience.  

Prior experience in corporate content creation, Social Media, and other creative content development is a plus.


COMPUTER SKILLS  

Possess intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and proficiency with PC and Mac platforms and tools. Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator) is a plus.


LANGUAGE SKILLS  

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and co\-workers.  

Ability to write clearly and with good logic, and ensure content has correct punctuation, grammar, and syntax.


REASONING ABILITY  

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Abilities to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Food & Beverage Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
Food \& Beverage Events Coordinator  

  

 **Job Overview**


The Maybourne Beverly Hills Hotel invites you to explore opportunities to push your creativity and be outstanding in a career that will bring out your craft and passion. We look for people that will share our vision and help bring it to life. If this is something you want to be a part of, we look forward to receiving your application.

**Summary of Position**


The Food \& Beverage Events Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and flawlessly executing luxury dining and special event experiences throughout the hotel. This role serves as the primary liaison between guests, clients, culinary teams, restaurant operations, and hotel departments, ensuring exceptional service, personalized experiences, and seamless event execution in alignment with Forbes Travel Guide and luxury hospitality standards.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, guest\-focused, detail\-oriented, and passionate about creating memorable experiences for discerning clientele, including VIPs, social events, corporate functions, private dining experiences, and special celebrations.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

*Job duties include; although are not limited to:*

* Manage all event inquiries from initial contact through post\-event follow\-up.
* Coordinate private dining events, afternoon tea experiences, executive meetings, cocktail receptions, buyouts, milestone celebrations, and hotel special events.
* Prepare detailed Restaurant Event Orders (REOs), contracts, proposals, and event timelines.
* Conduct hotel and venue site inspections with prospective clients.
* Coordinate menus, wine pairings, specialty cocktails, floral arrangements, entertainment, signage, and customized guest experiences.
* Ensure all event details, including dietary requirements, seating arrangements, room setup diagrams, and VIP preferences, are accurately communicated to operational teams.
* Deliver exceptional personalized service that exceeds guest expectations.
* Act as the primary contact for event hosts and organizers.
* Anticipate guest needs and proactively create memorable moments.
* Coordinate VIP arrivals, high\-profile clientele, and special recognition occasions.
* Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests, feedback, and concerns.
* Maintain confidentiality and discretion for all guests.
* Collaborate closely with Culinary, Pastry, Beverage, Restaurant, IRD, Stewarding,
* Ensure flawless execution of all food and beverage experiences consistent with Forbes and luxury hotel standards.
* Attend pre\-event meetings and operational briefings.
* Monitor events in real time to ensure service flow, presentation standards, and guest satisfaction.
* Address operational challenges quickly while maintaining a calm and professional demeanor.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Fusion Community Empowerment is looking for a high\-energy, organized, and resourceful Administrative \& Program Coordinator who enjoys being part of work that directly impacts the community.

We are a hands\-on nonprofit, which means no two days will look exactly the same. One day you may be coordinating participant appointments and organizing program files, and the next you may be helping prepare for a community event, following up with a partner, updating program data, or making sure the team has what they need to meet an important deadline.

We need someone who is comfortable taking initiative and doesn't need to be reminded of every next step. This person will work closely with the Executive Director and Program Director and will take ownership of many of the administrative details that keep our programs and organization moving.

This is more than answering phones and scheduling meetings. You will help us stay organized, responsive, accountable, and connected to the people we serve.

If you enjoy creating order, following things through to completion, working with different personalities, learning new systems, and being part of a mission\-driven team, you may be a great fit for Fusion.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to the Executive Director, Program Director, and program team.
* Manage calendars, schedule meetings and participant appointments, and help leadership stay ahead of important deadlines and commitments.
* Monitor incoming calls, emails, participant inquiries, and program requests and make sure they reach the appropriate team member.
* Support participant intake by monitoring submissions, scheduling intake appointments, identifying missing information, and maintaining organized participant files.
* Send routine participant reminders and follow up on documents, appointments, surveys, program requirements, and other outstanding items.
* Enter and maintain accurate participant and program information in spreadsheets, databases, housing/program management systems, and other internal platforms.
* Track program activity, participant progress, services provided, surveys, outcomes, and other information needed for program and grant reporting.
* Help keep our task\-management systems, calendars, shared drives, electronic files, and internal records organized and current.
* Prepare meeting agendas, take notes when needed, document action items, and help follow up with team members on outstanding tasks.
* Prepare letters, forms, spreadsheets, presentations, reports, sign\-in sheets, and other program materials.
* Assist with community events, workshops, trainings, outreach activities, and partner meetings from planning through follow\-up.
* Communicate professionally and compassionately with participants, community partners, vendors, volunteers, and other stakeholders.
* Assist with staff, intern, and volunteer onboarding and training logistics.
* Help manage office supplies, equipment, purchasing documentation, receipts, invoices, and other routine operational needs.
* Assist with social media, website updates, flyers, newsletters, and program communications when needed.
* Be willing to jump in and help with the small things that keep a nonprofit running. We work as a team, and sometimes that means stepping outside of your regular task list.

**Who We're Looking For**

*We're looking for someone who is:*

* **Proactive.** You don't always wait to be told what comes next.
* **Highly organized.** You can keep track of multiple people, deadlines, documents, and priorities without letting things fall through the cracks.
* **A strong follow\-through person.** Starting a task is important; finishing it is even more important.
* **Comfortable with change.** Nonprofit and community work can move quickly, and priorities sometimes shift.
* **Tech comfortable.** You can confidently work with email, calendars, spreadsheets, shared drives, databases, online forms, and task\-management systems and can learn new platforms quickly.
* **A strong communicator.** You can communicate professionally with leadership, staff, participants, and outside partners.
* **Compassionate with boundaries.** The people we serve may be experiencing housing instability, unemployment, financial hardship, reentry challenges, or other difficult circumstances. You should be able to treat every person with dignity while maintaining professional boundaries and following program procedures.
* **Solution\-oriented.** When something doesn't work, your first instinct is to figure out what the next option is.
* **Team\-minded.** Titles matter less than making sure the work gets done.

**Experience \& Qualifications**

* Previous administrative, program support, office coordination, nonprofit, human services, community\-based, or similar experience preferred.
* Experience working in a nonprofit or community\-based organization is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting programs serving diverse communities is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple responsibilities and deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, including Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, email, calendars, and shared files.
* Experience with databases, CRM systems, case\-management systems, Asana, QuickBooks, Canva, or similar platforms is a plus.
* Experience maintaining confidential participant or client information is preferred.
* Bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Experience:

jobs.title: Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
The Operations Assistant plays a critical role in maintaining the speed, accuracy, and reliability of day\-to\-day terminal operations. This position exists to ensure freight flows without disruption, operational data remains accurate in real time, and cross\-functional teams are aligned on execution.  

  

In a fast\-moving logistics environment, even small delays or communication gaps can create downstream inefficiencies. This role directly mitigates those risks by owning load visibility, coordinating with multiple internal and external
  

stakeholders, and ensuring operational systems reflect ground truth.  

  

Success in this role means shipments move predictably, exceptions are identified and escalated early, and the service center operates with precision, accountability, and minimal rework.
**What you’ll do**
==================

**1\. Drive operational coordination and load visibility**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Track outbound loads daily and ensure system updates are accurate and timely
* Proactively communicate delays to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders before 11 AM
* Monitor pickup schedules and investigate loads that have not departed by 10 AM
* Escalate operational risks and delays to Linehaul and leadership with clear context

**2\. Execute administrative and documentation workflows**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Manage driver documentation, including IC paperwork, plates, IFTA, and compliance materials
* Collect and route maintenance records to Safety to ensure compliance standards are met
* Manifest inbound and outbound freight, ensuring documentation accuracy across systems
* File and maintain exception reports and operational records

**3\. Support delivery execution and customer commitments**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Schedule delivery appointments, including direct deliveries and diverts
* Coordinate redeliveries and obtain ACR (Additional Charge Request) authorization
* Enter ACRs into systems with precision to ensure financial and operational alignment
* Partner with brokers to secure rates for non\-service point returns

**4\. Resolve operational exceptions and improve throughput**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Trace freight and investigate shipment issues across terminals and agent networks
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve delivery disruptions
* Identify recurring issues and escalate patterns that impact service performance
* Support all terminals with system\-related and operational inquiries

**5\. Maintain operational infrastructure and team efficiency**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor functionality of printers and administrative equipment within operations
* Provide general administrative support including data entry, filing, imaging, and reporting
* Preset appointments for inbound freight and linehaul contractors
* Contribute to team\-based operational goals and continuous improvement efforts

**What you bring**
==================

* High school diploma or GED required; equivalent experience considered
* 1–3 months of relevant administrative or operations experience preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact across all levels
* Basic computer proficiency; familiarity with AS/400, Microsoft Office, and imaging tools preferred
* Foundational math skills and comfort working with weights, distances, and monetary values
* Ability to read, interpret, and follow written and verbal instructions
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills in a fast\-paced environment
* Capacity to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with attention to detail
* Problem\-solving ability in situations with limited standardization
* Hazardous Materials Handling certification preferred
* Experience in transportation, logistics, or terminal operations is a plus

**How you operate**
===================

* You prioritize accuracy without sacrificing speed
* You take ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks
* You communicate early, clearly, and with purpose
* You thrive in structured environments but can adapt when conditions shift
* You stay organized and focused under operational pressure
* You collaborate effectively across functions to resolve issues quickly
* You approach problems with practicality and a solution\-first mindset


**Compensation \& Setup**
=========================

* **Compensation:** $18\.50 per hour
* **Location:** Onsite \| Commerce, CA
* **Benefits:** Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
=========================================


The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Light physical activity performing non\-strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature.
* While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, reach/handle items, work with fingers, have color vision (ability to identify and distinguish colors) and talk and hear others in conversations via the phone or in person.
* The employee is occasionally asked to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, climb or balance and lift objects up to 25 lbs.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

* The noise level is loud based on multiple printers and forklifts running outside of the door.
* Works in well\-lighted, heated and/or air\-conditioned indoor office setting with adequate ventilation.
* Might be required to occasionally work near toxic or caustic chemicals, moving mechanical parts and/or fumes or airborne

The TikTok LIVE Automotive team partners with top global automotive brands and their dealer networks to unlock live streaming as a new customer acquisition and lead generation channel. This role owns a portfolio of headline automotive KA (Key Account) brands end\-to\-end: co\-designing joint annual and campaign budgets, building the go\-live playbook with brand HQ and local dealers, driving live streaming quality and lead conversion on the ground, and turning early KA wins into scalable case studies that lift the whole automotive vertical. The goal is not more livestreams, it is real business outcomes (leads, test drives, orders) that make TikTok LIVE a must\-have channel for automotive marketing.
  
  

What you'll do
  
* KA account ownership: Own a portfolio of headline global automotive brands (OEMs and their dealer groups) as the primary TikTok LIVE point of contact, build multi\-level relationships across brand marketing, digital, retail, and agency stakeholders, and land TikTok LIVE inside their annual marketing and digital plan.

* Campaign execution: Design and land integrated campaigns around new car launches, auto shows, seasonal moments, and always\-on dealer live streaming, working with in\-app product entries, ads, creators, and offline events.
* Customer success \& LIVE ROI: Track full\-funnel performance (impressions, viewership, leads, CPL, dealer handoff, test drive, order), diagnose gaps, and iterate playbooks so each KA brand can prove positive live streaming ROI and renew / expand budget.
* Dealer \& creator ecosystem: Coordinate brand HQ, regional offices, country subsidiaries, dealer groups, and automotive creators into one live streaming operating model, and turn top\-performing dealers and creators into references that pull in the long tail.
* Playbook \& case sedimentation: Turn winning campaigns into repeatable automotive live streaming playbooks (by segment: mass\-market/NEV/used\-car, by market, by campaign type), and lead knowledge transfer to sales, dealer, and cross\-market teams.

* Bachelor's degree or above, with 5\+ years of automotive\-industry experience in one of the following backgrounds: (1\) automotive KA / brand partnership / sales roles at OEMs, dealer groups, automotive agencies, or automotive media / marketing platforms; (2\) prior experience at a leading Chinese automotive brand's global / overseas business.

FASTSIGNS North Hollywood is looking for an Outside Sales Representative to build our commercial customer base throughout Los Angeles.

FASTSIGNS North Hollywood is a locally owned sign and graphics company. We opened in May 2026 and are building the business from the ground up.  

We are a small, hands\-on team. You will work directly with the owner, design, production, and operations, and see the projects you sell move from initial conversation to installation.  

THE ROLE  

You will own new\-business development for the shop. Prospects may include general contractors, property managers, facility managers, commercial developers, multi\-location businesses, manufacturers, schools, medical groups, and local business owners.  

We provide tools, support, and leads, but you will be expected to actively build relationships and develop a territory.

Understand job costs and gross profit so projects are sold profitably

* Comfortable with cold outreach and starting conversations with new prospects

Valid California driver's license, reliable transportation, and clean driving record

COMPENSATION  

**Base salary: $40,000–$50,000, depending on experience, plus uncapped commission.**  

**Commission: 10% of gross profit on qualified sales.**  

Gross profit is job revenue minus direct job costs, including materials, outsourced production, subcontracted installation, permits, freight, and other direct project costs. Shop overhead and salaries are not deducted.  

Commission is paid after customer payment is received.  

Qualified sales include new business you source, dormant accounts you reactivate, existing accounts you materially grow, and inbound opportunities over $2,500 that you personally scope, estimate, and close. Routine walk\-in and small repeat orders are handled by other team members.

jobs.title: Client Partner, NimbleRx (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
**At Swoop, our mission is simple:** Improving patient outcomes. As a market leader in AI\-driven, data\-powered, and privacy\-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.
  
  

Our integrated, privacy\-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI\-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.
  
  

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026\. We are driven by a patient\-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.
  
  

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer\-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.
  
  

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast\-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.
  
  

About the role
  
  

The Client Partner owns the post\-launch success of a portfolio of NimbleRx pharmacy partners. You’ll combine strong relationship management, technical product fluency, and data\-driven account management to help pharmacies get more value from NimbleRx, improve performance, adopt new capabilities, and grow revenue. You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for your partners while working closely with Support, Product, and Engineering when deeper technical expertise is required.
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Effectively train and manage a book of business of NimbleRx pharmacy partners, providing proactive solutions to using NimbleRx and recommending services/features to improve pharmacy revenue and performance.
  
Serve as a product and technical advisor, helping partners understand NimbleRx workflows and integrations, and how to get the most value from the platform.
  
Analyze partner performance data to identify adoption, revenue, and operational opportunities and translate insights into clear recommendations.
  
Actively impact pharmacy partner success by understanding pharmacists’ workflows, recurring issues, and product performance.
  
Utilize performance and revenue reports to share potential adoption and growth opportunities with key decision\-makers.
  
Develop durable relationships with pharmacy owners and staff, serving as their primary strategic point of contact.
  
Own the customer experience through complex escalations, partnering with Support, Product, and Engineering to drive resolution.
  
Develop enough technical fluency to guide partners through common integration questions and identify when specialized technical support is needed.
  
Translate pharmacy workflows and business needs into clear context for Product, Support, and Engineering.
  
Work closely with Product and Engineering to stay updated on new features.
  
Use dashboards, reporting tools, and SQL where appropriate to understand account performance and identify actions.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

4\+ years of experience in account management, partner/customer success, account retention, upgrading/upselling accounts, client support, or sales
  
A positive attitude and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving environment
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
Pharmacy experience highly preferred, but not required
  
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  
  

This role offers a base salary plus commission.

jobs.title: Special Education Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Amethod Public Schools (AMPS) is a mission and values\-driven organization. Our mission is to provide a fundamental and rigorous college preparatory education to any student who chooses one of our schools. Our day\-to\-day work is embodied with a set of core values: **Students First, Be Adaptable,** **Persevere, Take Responsibility, and Commitment to Distinction** or team members who exude these values and a passion for our mission.

**Position Summary**


Under the direction of the Chief Academic Officer or Special Education Designee, the Program Specialist assists and provides administrative support in all matters pertaining to key functions of the Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA), including but not limited to: contract documentation; reconciliation of special education invoices with special education services defined in Individual Education Programs (IEPs); IEP compliance and monitoring; professional development; timely/accurate reporting to the California Department of Education Special Education Division; and managing special education transportation.

**Major duties and responsibilities:**

* Plans programs, provides curricular resources and technical assistance for, and assesses the effectiveness of the program for students with exceptional needs for all Amethod schools
* Ensures the use of best practices in the implementation of pre\-referral behavioral interventions, positive behavioral interventions as outlined in the IEP, and implementation of behavioral support and intervention plans by collaborating with school psychologists, other specialists, or site staff, including providing professional development as needed
* Provides leadership in the area of curriculum, instruction, and modification/accommodation for students with diverse learning needs
* Participates in professional development and provides training and support to the Special Ed Team to enhance instruction for students with social communication, behavioral, and learning challenges
* Assumes responsibility for appropriate identification, educational programming, and services for special education students
* Leverages individual and cultural diversity, demonstrating knowledge and understanding of working with ELL students
* Provides support for data\-driven decision\-making and accountability to improve the instructional program and ensure student progress
* Ensures due process requirements are met to complete the appropriate development of IEPs and provides ongoing monitoring to ensure IDEA compliance
* Participates in evaluation of Ed Specialists and Paraprofessionals and provides support to Principals in the supervision of special education team members.
* Manages complex cases to ensure appropriate special education services, including attending staffing meetings, IEP meetings, and parent conferences
* Applies conflict resolution strategies with parents or other educational partners to resolve disputes related to a student’s IEP, demonstrating knowledge of current IDEA and Amethod policy and procedures
* Assists in the design and facilitation of network\-wide professional development for staff, including onboarding of Special Education team members
* Participate in the designing and redesigning of the Amethod special educational program
* Assists in recruiting and screening of special education staff
* Conduct class observation and speak with teachers to support and monitor all behavioral RTI data
* Support in planning and implementing teacher in\-service and professional development at each school site
* Perform other related duties as required and assigned

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Broad understanding of the MTSS/RTI structure as it relates to school reform
* Ability to use data for decision\-making regarding student needs
* Ability to support professional development in all aspects of intervention methods both academic and behavioral needs
* Ability to work in a high demand environment
* Proven successful teaching or related service experience in Special Education

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Clear CA Education Specialist Credential and CLAD certification required OR CA Related Service Provider Credential/License (School Psychology, Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, etc.)
* CPI certification desired
* Bilingual\- Spanish desired
* Minimum 3 years of related experience in special education leadership

**Compensation**


The salary range for this position is $85,000 \- $105,000\. Salary is commensurate with experience, education, and expertise. A competitive benefits package is also offered. This is a full\-time, exempt, 100% in\-person position.

jobs.title: CAP-CT Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program and / or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management and implementation; interprets, monitors and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.


**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments / projects / tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Custom Scope**

The UCSF Division of Geriatrics seeks to recruit a full\-time **Program Coordinator** to support the implementation and operational ownership of a Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) funded program, Caregivers as Partners in Care Teams (CAP\-CT). This position reports to the Program Director and supports/leads a wide\-range of project operations and coordination tasks. The Program Coordinator will perform a broad range of duties that will require analytical, organizational, communication, technical, and coordination skills. Specific duties include: coordinating and maintaining project timelines and deliverables, assisting with researching and applying relevant policies, data collection, management, analyses and reporting, preparing and updating program materials/protocols/procedures, coordinating meeting schedules/agendas/minutes, drafting and updating documents, making program\-related purchases and submitting expense reports, conducting literature searches/reviews, and supporting manuscript preparation/scholarly dissemination. The Program Coordinator will additionally function as a subject matter expert and provide oversight and direction on learning management systems, manage digital education platforms, CE/CME accreditation coordination, analytics reporting, marketing communications, website management, and operational support across multiple projects and conferences. This position requires the ability to be proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of flexibility. An ideal candidate will be able to work independently with minimal supervision, balances multiple competing priorities at any given time, and is intellectually curious, willing to learn new skills and a problem\-solver. The Program Coordinator may be required to provide the same level of support across projects/programs where there is a need.

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator / Administrative Assistant - Kitchen Remodeling
jobs.description:
Sales Coordinator / Administrative Assistant \- Kitchen Remodeling

**Keane Kitchens \- San Mateo, CA**

**Pay:** $24\-$30 per hour, depending on experience \| **Full\-Time** \| Monday\-Friday  
**Work Location:** In Person \- San Mateo Showroom

**About Keane Kitchens:**

Founded in 1992, Keane Kitchens is a family\-owned Bay Area kitchen remodeling company built on craftsmanship, integrity, attention to detail, and great customer service.

We are looking for an organized, personable, and dependable Sales Coordinator / Administrative Assistant to join our San Mateo showroom and provide dedicated support to one salesperson.

This is an important support role within our sales process. You'll help keep customer appointments, communication, paperwork, estimates, project information, and follow\-ups organized so that customers receive a professional and responsive experience from beginning to end.

**About the Position:**

We're looking for someone who already has experience in an administrative, sales support, project coordination, or similar professional role and is comfortable managing multiple priorities at once.

You do not need previous kitchen or cabinetry experience. We can teach you our products, design process, and how we operate. However, you should already have a strong foundation in organization, customer communication, attention to detail, and follow\-through.

The right person will enjoy staying organized, working with customers, solving small problems before they become bigger ones, and helping keep a busy salesperson and their projects on track.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with one salesperson as their primary administrative and sales support
* Manage and coordinate customer appointments and the salesperson's schedule
* Confirm appointments and help prepare necessary information and materials beforehand
* Keep customer files, paperwork, selections, and project information organized and up to date
* Assist with estimates, proposals, contracts, and other sales documents
* Track outstanding customer information, selections, measurements, decisions, and other project details
* Follow up with customers by phone and email as needed
* Answer incoming phone calls and assist customers professionally
* Help manage routine customer emails and communication
* Assist the salesperson and customers during showroom appointments when needed
* Organize samples, product selections, and presentation materials
* Communicate with customers, vendors, installers, and other team members
* Keep track of open tasks and make sure important items are followed through to completion
* Help maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming showroom
* Learn our products and processes and take on additional responsibilities as you become comfortable in the role

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required:**

* 1\+ year of experience in administrative support, sales support, project coordination, office administration, executive assistance, or a similar professional support role
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Professional and friendly communication skills
* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone, email, and in person
* Experience managing appointments, schedules, paperwork, and follow\-up tasks
* Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and priorities at the same time
* Comfortable using computers, email, calendars, documents, and spreadsheets
* Dependable, punctual, and consistent
* Strong follow\-through and ability to keep track of outstanding tasks
* Proactive and willing to take initiative
* Comfortable working closely with and supporting one salesperson

**Preferred, but not required:**

Experience in kitchen and bath, cabinetry, remodeling, construction, interior design, architecture, home improvement, or another project\-based industry is a strong plus.

**Who Will Do Well in This Role:**

You'll likely be a great fit if you're the type of person who likes keeping things organized and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You notice when something needs to be followed up on, communicate professionally with customers, keep good records, and are comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities.

We're happy to teach you cabinetry, our products, and the Keane Kitchens process. We're looking for someone who already knows how to be organized, dependable, professional, and proactive.

**Why Keane Kitchens?:**

Keane Kitchens has been family\-owned and operated since 1992\. We're a small business where customer relationships, quality work, and attention to detail matter.

You'll work directly alongside an experienced salesperson and become an important part of their day\-to\-day sales operation. You'll learn the kitchen remodeling business, interact directly with customers, and have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as you gain experience.

For the right person, there is an opportunity to grow with the company over time.

**Expected Hours:** 40 hours per week  
**Schedule:** Monday\-Friday

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Please apply through Indeed with your resume and a brief introduction describing your previous administrative, sales support, or project coordination experience.

Applicants must have at least 1 year of relevant professional experience to be considered.

jobs.description:
Role Name: Lead Recruiting Coordinator


Department: Talent


Location: San Carlos


Shift:


### **About 1X**


We’re building humanoid robots that work in home \- doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it’s not.


To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing \- at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the *hard work* is in front of us.


NEO is our flagship \- a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it \- we’re shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.


If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world \- this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time \- safely creating abundance for all.

### **About the Team:**


The Talent team hires the people who build NEO: robotics, AI, manufacturing, and the teams that support them. Recruiting Coordination is the operating layer of that work. Every interview, every candidate touchpoint, and every record in Ashby runs through this team, so when coordination is excellent, 1X hires faster and candidates leave every conversation wanting to work here.

### **Your Charter:**


The mission of this role is to give a seamless experience during every interview, and to make the coordination function faster every quarter. You are one of two Lead Recruiting Coordinators. Each of you owns half of the hiring org end to end, from scheduling and candidate communication to data integrity in Ashby. You lead by setting the standard for quality and speed, and by being the person the team turns to when something breaks. Hiring speed is on 1X’s critical path, and this role is where that speed is won or lost day to day.

### **Key Outcomes:**

* Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling for executive and high\-volume roles in your half of the org, delivered without errors, with last\-minute conflicts resolved quickly and calmly.
* Deliver consistently high satisfaction scores from candidates and hiring managers through transparent, timely communication with every interview participant.
* Drive down time\-to\-schedule and time\-to\-feedback by identifying bottlenecks in the hiring workflow and implementing automation for scheduling and feedback collection.
* Optimize and iterate the coordination team’s playbooks and training guides so every coordinator runs the same process and new hires ramp fast.
* Lead as the escalation point for daily operational issues in your half of the org, setting the bar for quality and speed across the coordination team, and keep Ashby complete and current as the single source of truth for every open role.

### **Key Competencies:**

* Handles confidential candidates, compensation, and offer information with total accuracy and discretion.
* Stays calm and decisive when a schedule breaks an hour before the interview, and fixes it without creating noise for the candidate or the panel.
* Thinks in systems: sees a repeated problem and fixes the process, not only the instance.
* Communicates clearly and proactively with executives, hiring managers, and candidates, in writing and live.
* Sets a high standard and holds peers to it without direct authority.

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of recruiting coordination experience, including scheduling for executive or high\-volume roles
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi\-participant interview schedules without errors
* Experience with an applicant tracking system as the system of record for hiring
* Proven track record of being the escalation point for a coordination or operations team

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in Ashby
* Experience in implementing scheduling automation or workflow tooling, such as ATS integrations or no\-code automations
* Exposure to writing team playbooks, standard operating procedures, or training documentation
* Familiarity with hiring for hardware, robotics, or AI teams

### **What does a successful 1X Team Member look like:**


Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back \- because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

$100,000 \- $125,000

jobs.description:
Logistics Operations Coordinator – Robotics

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Locations:** Mountain View, CA  
**Positions Available:** 2

**Mountain View:** On\-site attendance required  
**Cambridge:** Remote working can be considered; candidates must be available to work Eastern Time (ET) hours

About the Opportunity

We are supporting a world\-leading advanced technology organization to expand its Logistics Operations function within a cutting\-edge **robotics, engineering and R\&D environment**.

We are seeking Logistics Operations Coordinators to take ownership of the day\-to\-day movement of specialist equipment, components, materials and other assets required by technical teams.

This is a hands\-on operational logistics position where accuracy, organization and reliable execution are critical. You will manage shipments from initial request through to final delivery, ensuring appropriate documentation is in place, processes are followed and stakeholders have clear visibility throughout.

You will work closely with robotics and laboratory teams, internal operations functions, suppliers and logistics partners to ensure equipment and materials reach the right location safely, compliantly and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the day\-to\-day logistics pipeline, coordinating shipments from initial request through to final delivery.
* Coordinate the domestic and international movement of specialist equipment, components and materials supporting robotics, engineering and R\&D activities.
* Act as a key operational point of contact for internal robotics, engineering and laboratory teams requiring shipments.
* Gather accurate shipment requirements and ensure all necessary information is captured prior to dispatch.
* Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, freight providers and other external partners.
* Obtain and maintain accurate shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, customs information and relevant regulatory paperwork.
* Ensure shipments are processed in line with established internal procedures and applicable customs and legal requirements.
* Track shipments throughout the delivery lifecycle and provide clear, timely updates to stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and logistics data using spreadsheets, tracking tools and internal systems.
* Proactively identify potential delays, documentation gaps, compliance issues and other risks that could impact delivery.
* Escalate bottlenecks and operational issues to the Logistics Manager to support rapid resolution.
* Identify recurring issues or areas of non\-compliance within the logistics pipeline.
* Support a fast\-paced technical environment where the timely availability of equipment and materials is critical to ongoing robotics and engineering programs.

Experience \& Skills

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and highly organized logistics professional who is comfortable taking ownership of multiple shipments and priorities.

You should have:

* Previous experience in logistics, shipping, supply chain coordination or a similar process\-driven operational role.
* Practical knowledge of domestic and/or international shipping processes.
* Experience working with shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, shipping terms and customs documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling shipping documentation and operational data.
* Experience working within established processes, policies and compliance requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive approach to identifying and escalating issues.
* Experience with spreadsheets, data entry, shipment tracking tools or logistics systems.
* The ability to operate effectively within a fast\-paced, global environment.

Desirable Experience

Experience within one or more of the following environments would be particularly valuable:

* Robotics and automation
* Engineering and advanced technology
* Research \& Development
* Laboratory or technical facilities
* Electronics and hardware
* Aerospace or automotive
* Manufacturing or industrial technology
* Scientific or research organizations

Experience coordinating **high\-value, specialist, technical or sensitive equipment** would also be advantageous.

The Environment

This is not a traditional high\-volume warehouse or distribution role.

You will be supporting specialist robotics, engineering and R\&D teams that rely on the efficient movement of technical equipment, components and materials.

The role requires someone who can combine strong logistics fundamentals with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively in a highly technical, fast\-moving environment.

Pay: $26\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person
