jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Harmless Harvest envisions a world where nutritious, clean, organic and healthy food and beverages are the standard rather than the exception; where all people involved in creating the product are treated with fairness; and the planet is treated harmlessly. We are focused on changing the world, and we are always looking for like\-minded, wildly passionate individuals to help us to do this.

**About the Role:**


The Accounts Manager will exhibit eagerness to learn the true ins and outs of account management – both internal and external facing. Qualified candidates should have a deep aspiration to grow and develop their regional/national accounts and the overall Harmless Harvest business. The ideal candidate is a team\-player, willing to get their hands dirty, is passionate to paint the streets green \& white, and is a selling machine!


The Accounts Manager is responsible for managing regional chain accounts and independents ranging from $10K to over $250K in annual revenue and managing brokers and distributors to maximize all opportunities to drive sales and profit growth in the Natural channel.




**What you’ll be doing:**

* Develop and deliver impactful customer presentations, business reviews, and strategic promotional plans to positively shape customer strategy and provide insights \& solutions for profitable growth
* Identify, prioritize, pursue, secure and scale business with new customers, to deliver Annual Operating Plan (AOP) objectives (nets sales and profit)
* Effectively manage and grow existing business with your key customers, accelerating both top and bottom line
* Utilize data sources to analyze and capitalize on sales opportunities
* Serve as a point person in understanding and identifying market sales trends for your accounts using syndicated data
* Deliver/exceed established sales targets and quotas on time and within trade budget parameters
* Develop and execute situation assessments, objectives, strategies and execution plans for targeted accounts
* Possess a strong working understanding of each customer's strategy, organization, Marketing/R\&D, and decision\-making process
* Manage direct communication and strategy with local distributors/brokers and field sales reps
* Work cross functionally internally with marketing, innovation, demand planning teams, etc. and externally to maximize selling efforts and achieve business objectives




**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Minimum 1\-3 years of experience in CPG sales across MULO \&/or Natural channel
* Minimum 1\-2 years in direct customer management
* Proficient with MS Office Suite (Excel, PPT, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc), SPINS or comparable syndicated data source, Vividly or comparable trade tool management
* Must have a strong understanding and experience with basic trade math, consumption data, trade spend, sales reports, promo spend and funding, demand planning, presentation building and presenting, etc.
* Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to foster new relationships, active listening to understand team and customer needs
* Strong analytical skills with ability to identify trends in sales data
* Strong organizational and time management skills, comfort with fast\-paced sales environment and problem solving
* Team player mentality, willingness to collaborate with team members and work cross\-functionally
* Background in perishable products is a plus




**Benefits:**

* Competitive Compensation (Base Salary \& Bonus)
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental, \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (Traditional 401k \& Roth 401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary, AD\&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick, Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability




* The salary range for this role may vary above or below the posted range as determined by location. This range has not been adjusted for any specific geographic differential applicable by area where the position may be filled. Compensation takes into account several factors including but not limited to a candidate’s experience, education, skills, relevant certifications, department equity, training and organizational needs. Base pay is just one piece of the total rewards program offered by Harmless Harvest which includes comprehensive perks and health benefits.


At Harmless Harvest, we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion as catalysts for innovation and success. We are dedicated to fostering a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, believing that this enriches our creativity and strengthens our service to customers and communities alike.


Harmless Harvest is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Harmless Harvest via\-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Harmless Harvest. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Harmless Harvest as a result of the referral or through other means.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Sep 15, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30276**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro Computer is looking for an Account Manager who has experience with selling technical solutions and developing business. The ideal candidate must also have a proven track record in winning enterprise level relationships and consistently achieving and exceeding assigned sales quotas.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* Manage products through their entire lifecycle until product EOL


* Develop strategic sales goals with exceptional execution to meet the sales target


* Qualify leads and creating target lists of enterprise or data center accounts


* Seek potential customers (e.g., Corporate Customers, Value\-Added Resellers, OEMs) through cold calling and follow\-up customer visits


* Participate in marketing activities such as trade shows to generate leads


* Ability to strategically positioned Supermicro’s products and services in the market


* Develop customer relationships and maintain/manage accounts, expand existing client accounts for retention and potential growth


* Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts


* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations


* Negotiate sales pricing, monitoring orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating sales returns


**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor degree in business, engineering or similar fields preferred
* 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience with selling computer hardware solutions to data center or enterprise accounts (prior software or telecom sales will be considered) preferred
* Successful track record with credible cold calling and follow\-up with key decision makers
* Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
* Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
* Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation
* Extremely proactive, highly organized, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks
* Exceptional management skill in time and territory


**Salary Range**
----------------


$72,500 \- $104,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.


**EEO Statement**
-----------------


Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Additional Job Description**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**


 This is an exciting opportunity with CoolIT Systems, the leading provider of scalable liquid cooling technology, as a Key Account Manager (hunter focused) for targeted cloud service provider/Hyperscaler customers. In this role, you will be expected to aggressively identify, pursue, and win strategic opportunities, expand wallet share, and convert high\-value prospects into long\-term customers. Join our rapidly growing organization and make an impact in the data center industry by driving new business growth and accelerating market penetration.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own the development and execution of a territory and account strategy focused on hunting, penetrating, and winning 1\-3 named hyperscale liquid cooling customers or prospects.
* Understand client needs and our competitive positioning, challenges, and goals to offer tailored solutions for their cooling requirements to enable growth in sales.
* Act as the primary commercial lead for target accounts, driving outbound engagement, uncovering opportunities early, qualifying demand, and advancing prospects through the sales cycle to close.
* Consistently build, progress, and close a high\-quality pipeline that meets or exceeds CoolIT's program pipeline, bookings, and forecast targets.
* Lead review and negotiation of customer contracts and manage inputs from stakeholders to drive execution of contracts.
* Develop and execute account penetration plans that create double\-digit revenue growth through new program wins, competitive displacement, and expansion into adjacent opportunities.
* Demonstrate technical expertise in data center operations and cooling solutions.
* Collaborate internally with Operations to ensure successful project execution from initial discussions to delivery and implementation.
* Maintain a sharp point of view on industry trends, competitor moves, whitespace opportunities, and customer buying triggers to inform pursuit strategy.
* Provide market insights and voice of customer feedback to guide product development and innovation.
* Continuously monitor performance metrics and quality standards, driving continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Potential for travel up to 40% domestically and up to 25% internationally.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

**Basic Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, or account management, with a strong preference for candidates who have excelled in hunter\-oriented roles.
* 4\+ years of experience working in a manufacturing or advanced technology business.
* Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Proven track record of winning complex enterprise sales in a sales\-led organization, including originating opportunities, shaping deals, and closing with Fortune 50 clients.
* Demonstrated experience with the big 5 Cloud Service Providers.
* Strong commercial instincts with a bias for action, persistence, and accountability in pursuing revenue and customer outcomes.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Legally authorized to work in (Country) without company sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Preference for strong technical background, with experience in data center infrastructure, cooling systems, or related fields.
* Experience using CRM and ERP systems such as Oracle Netsuite (preferred), SAP, Salesforce, or ServiceNow.

**Skills:**


* Strategic hunter mindset with a demonstrated ability to open doors, build pursuit plans, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and win high\-value business.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills; ability to work effectively under time constraints and deliver results by critical deadlines.
* Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams across all levels of the organization.
* High drive, resilience, and urgency, with the ability to adapt quickly, overcome obstacles, and maintain momentum in competitive sales cycles.

  



**WHY COOLIT?**


We strive to be an employer of choice and as such we believe in rewarding our employees with career and development opportunities that will maintain and strengthen our culture while aligning to our vision and values.


We are a company that is full of vibrant, innovative people who love what we do. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

* Vacation and flex days, and paid company\-wide shutdown during the holiday season.
* Comprehensive benefits including Dental, Drugs, Optical, Paramedical and Health Spending. These costs are covered by CoolIT and are enacted from your first day.
* Dress for your day – in a casual yet professional environment.
* Retention rewards like “The Big Coffee Break” that reward tenure with additional vacation time and a monetary bonus.
* Company\-funded RRSP contributions to support your long\-term financial goals.


We thank every candidate in advance, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks including criminal records check and education.

**About CoolIT, An Ecolab Company**


Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.


Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.


As demand for generative AI, high performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

jobs.title: 2027 Account Management Summer Internship
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Interested in the insurance industry but more drawn to client service, problem\-solving, and building long\-term relationships than traditional sales?  

Heffernan’s Insurance Service Internship provides an inside look at what it takes to deliver exceptional service to insurance clients. You’ll work alongside experienced insurance professionals and gain hands\-on exposure to the day\-to\-day operations of an insurance brokerage.  

Throughout the 10\-week program, you’ll learn how insurance policies and client relationships are managed after the sale, how service teams support clients throughout the policy lifecycle, and how different departments work together to deliver an exceptional client experience.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Shadow experienced insurance service professionals and account teams.
* Learn how insurance accounts are managed and serviced throughout the policy lifecycle.
* Gain exposure to client communication, account management, renewals, and day\-to\-day client needs
* Assist with research, account preparation, and other service\-related projects.
* Learn how insurance policies, coverage, and documentation are organized and managed.
* Participate in client meetings and team meetings when appropriate.
* Learn how service teams partner with insurance carriers and internal departments.
* Gain exposure to different areas of insurance, including commercial insurance, business insurance, employee benefits, and/or personal lines.
* Assist with data gathering, analysis, and preparation of client materials.
* Learn how service teams identify and resolve client issues.
* Develop an understanding of the relationship between sales, service, and the overall client experience.
* Participate in insurance education and training opportunities.
* Complete an intern group project and present your work to Heffernan leadership.
* Participate in networking, mentoring, and professional development activities throughout the summer.

  

### **What We Are Looking For**

  

* Students entering their sophomore, junior, or senior year of college. Graduating seniors will also be considered.
* Interested in insurance, client service, account management, or business operations.
* Strong communicators who enjoy helping others and solving problems.
* Detail\-oriented and organized.
* Comfortable learning new systems, processes, and concepts.
* Curious and willing to ask questions.
* Able to work collaboratively with a team.
* Reliable, motivated, and willing to take initiative.
* Collaborative and comfortable working as part of a team.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative.
* A minimum 3\.0 GPA preferred.
* Ability to receive coaching and feedback and apply it to improve performance.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
* Professional demeanor and behavior are required, as referenced in Heffernan’s core values (Habits)

  

### **Why Heffernan?**

  

At Heffernan, our mission is simple: Answer the Phone and Have Fun! We pride ourselves on creating an environment where people enjoy their work while delivering for our clients. As an intern, you'll work side\-by\-side with experienced professionals, build relationships across the organization, participate in networking and social events, and gain real\-world experience that can help launch your career.
  

Regardless of your internship path, you’ll be part of a summer cohort and have opportunities to:* Participate in insurance and professional development training.
* Meet with and learn from Heffernan leaders.
* Work on a team\-based intern project.
* Attend networking, social, and community events.
* Participate in workshops focused on resumes, interviewing, personal branding, and career development.
* Receive one\-on\-one coaching and mentoring.
* Present your final project to Heffernan leadership.
* Build relationships with other interns and employees across the organization.

  

**Heffernan Habits (Expectations):**
These are practices that represent our unique culture.* **Answer The Phone (And Email)**: Communication is the foundation of success in life, work, and relationships. It begins with being present and responsive to both clients and colleagues. Listen to what is said and notice what goes unsaid.
* **Have Fun**: Fun is something we don’t shy away from, and participation brings us together on many different levels. Take the time to know your colleagues and let barriers fall away. If we are happy and enjoy time together, we will do a better job for our clients and for one another!
* **Be Respectful:** Lend a hand, be kind, and smooth the path. Respect is the cornerstone of developing and maintaining strong relationships. Lead with humility, take ownership of your actions, and ease the way for others. We are in this together as a team, as a family, and as trusted advisors to many.
* **Do Good**: This is our core. We strive to do good for our clients, our community, and our planet.
* **Celebrate \& Value Our Differences**: “Because You’re Different”. It is our differences, when valued and amplified, that allow us to innovate, to learn, to connect, and to stand apart from the rest.

  

### **About Heffernan Insurance Brokers**

jobs.title: Account Manager – CSP & ODM/CM Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

JPC Connectivity is seeking an energetic, proactive, and detail\-oriented Associate Account Manager to join our Silicon Valley team in Milpitas, CA. This position is a high\-growth career runway designed for early\-career professionals or ambitious entry\-level talent eager to build a career in the high\-speed data center, server, and cloud infrastructure industries. In this role, you will serve as a key commercial and operational bridge connecting top\-tier Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), Taiwanese Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), Contract Manufacturers (CMs), and JPC’s global engineering and manufacturing teams in Taiwan. You will be coached to manage accounts end\-to\-end—driving project execution from early\-stage New Product Introduction (NPI) into high\-volume Mass Production (MP), maintaining strong customer rapport, and identifying new hardware design\-win opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Account Coordination \& Ecosystem Management**

● Serve as Primary Liaison: Act as the daily operational point of contact for assigned CSP procurement teams and their tier\-1 ODM/CM partners (e.g., Foxconn, Quanta, Wiwynn, Inventec).

● Relationship Building: Develop and nurture professional networks across customer procurement, engineering, program management, and supply chain departments.

● Customer Support: Track day\-to\-day customer requests, sample orders, open action items, and technical queries to ensure rapid turnaround times and complete execution.

**2\. NPI\-to\-Mass Production Project Orchestration**

● Lifecycle Tracking: Monitor engineering programs across early architecture phase, sample builds, qualification (EVT/DVT/PVT stages), and smooth transition into mass production (MP).

● Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with customer project managers and internal quality, engineering, and factory leads to resolve engineering change orders (ECOs), quality inquiries, and delivery bottlenecks.

● Demand Pull\-Through: Ensure design approvals at the CSP architectural level accurately translate into production orders and forecast allocations at ODM/CM assembly sites.

**3\. Cross\-Regional Collaboration (US–Taiwan Bridge)**

● HQ \& Factory Engagement: Maintain daily communication with JPC’s Taiwan account management, engineering, and manufacturing teams to align project timelines, cost targets, and product specifications.

● Time\-Zone Agility: Participate in periodic evening coordination calls with Taiwan teams to accelerate urgent project requirements and address global time\-zone differences.

**4\. Commercial \& Business Operations**

● RFQ \& Quotation Support: Coordinate quotation requests (RFQs), gather cost structures from Taiwan engineering, calculate pricing margins, and deliver polished commercial proposals.

● Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain accurate program trackers, revenue forecasts, CRM records, meeting minutes, and executive account summaries.

● Account Expansion: Learn JPC’s technology portfolio (High\-Speed DAC/AEC, Optical Transceivers, Power Connectors, Custom Harnesses) to proactively identify cross\-selling opportunities within existing customer platforms.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **Position: Account Manager**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA**


Amphenol High Speed and Commercial Products Groups are the market leaders for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom and Diverse market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales, and manufacturing locations globally. We are currently seeking an Account Manager to join our West Coast Sales team in Santa Clara, CA.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


The Account Manager is the voice of the customer into the organization as well as the voice of Amphenol out to the customer. This highly visible role will have responsibility for one of the largest OEM customers within the High Speed Products Group. The position requires excellent communication skills but also has a substantial focus on financial and market data.

* Preparing monthly and quarterly revenue projections for the account(s)
* Forecast analysis and preparing book\-to\-ship estimates
* Preparing negotiation strategy in conjunction with sales and product line management, submitting proposals and negotiating order fulfillment agreements to maximize share
* Coordinating customer activities, including product ramp strategies and resolution of delivery, quality, inventory, and financial issues in an international environment
* Prepare market share goals and work with sales, product management and operations to achieve those objectives and resolve any shortfalls to the plan
* Identify end customer market analysis/opportunities and develop plans to fulfill gaps to close the total available market space


A successful candidate will be skilled at working with a high level of detail and will be able to manage multiple tasks for customers in a time sensitive environment. They will also make presentations to top management; organizational skills and summarizing conclusions via data analysis is an important part of the position. To do so requires a strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to communicate effectively. Some travel may be required.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* BS Degree in Marketing, Business or related area, MBA preferred
* Bi\-lingual Spanish/English Required
* Advanced PC Skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint, working ability with V\-lookups, Pivot Tables, and other more advanced excel skills
* 3\+ year of experience in Marketing, Customer Service, Planning or Finance
* Ability to effectively communicate across multiple functions internally and externally
* Strong oral and written communications to provide high level customer service and build relationships
* Detail\-oriented with keen business acumen


The base salary range for this position is $68,320 \- $104,400 annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.

  

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.


Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

* Develop and execute strategic growth initiatives targeting robotics startups, AI companies, venture\-backed technology firms, research institutions, and innovation ecosystems throughout Northern California and North America, positioning FANUC as the preferred robotics platform for advanced applications in artificial intelligence, machine learning, autonomous systems, physical AI, simulation, and robotic software
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with founders, CTOs, robotics architects, AI researchers, engineering executives, venture investors, universities, robotics laboratories, startup accelerators, incubators, and innovation centers to influence automation technology adoption and identify emerging business opportunities

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Creator Economy runs on two things creators can't get a straight answer on: what their content is actually earning across platforms, and when that money lands in their account. We're solving both.

Over 1\.2 million Creators across 50\+ countries rely on ChannelMeter for the data behind their business—performance and monetization reporting across platforms beyond YouTube—and for the payments infrastructure that turns that data into money in their bank account. We've processed $1\.8B\+ in payments for Creator Networks, agencies, IP distributors, and global brands, and the analytics layer underneath is just as core to what we do as the payment rails.

The market is heading toward $500B by 2027, and most of the infrastructure to support it—on the data side and the money side—doesn't exist yet. We're building it, and we need someone who can speak fluently to both halves of that problem for every customer who depends on us.

**Why this role exists**

Our customers don't show up with one kind of question. One week it's "why does my YouTube monetization number look off," the next it's "where's my payment," and often it's both at once, tangled together. This isn't a check\-in\-once\-a\-quarter role—you'll be embedded in how our customers understand their own data and their own money, spotting risk before it becomes churn and opportunity before anyone has to ask for it. And you'll do it with AI as a core part of how you work, not an add\-on: Claude, Codex, and Claude Cowork are expected tools here, not optional ones.

**What you'll own**

**Own the full customer relationship**

\- Guide customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, building trust with everyone from day\-to\-day operators to economic buyers

\- Manage a tiered portfolio—hands\-on for our largest Creator Networks and agencies, and scalable playbooks (lifecycle campaigns, in\-product prompts, proactive outreach) for the rest, so growth doesn't just mean more headcount

**Be fluent in the data, not just the money**

\- Help customers interpret their own performance and monetization data—including YouTube monetization trends—as confidently as they'd want a finance person to explain a payment

\- Spot data anomalies (a channel's reported earnings not matching what a customer expects) before they turn into a support escalation or a trust problem

\- Track account health against a mix of signals—retention, expansion, NPS/sentiment, and data/usage patterns—not payment metrics alone

**Turn signals into action**

\- Partner with Risk and Finance on underwriting\-adjacent questions and payment escalations, and with Data and Product on reporting or monetization discrepancies—most real issues touch both

\- Feed what you're hearing from customers back into Product in a structured way, not just as one\-off tickets

**Build the playbook as you go**

\- Use your AI toolkit daily—prep for calls, draft QBRs, summarize account history, and flag risk patterns before they surface

\- Keep a tight, structured pipeline in your task management system—every commitment and renewal date owned, nothing left to memory

\- Help define what great customer success looks like at ChannelMeter as we build out the function

**Who you are**

\- 3–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer\-facing SaaS/B2B role

\- Already fluent with AI tools like Claude, Codex, or Cowork in your daily workflow—this is the single biggest predictor of success here

\- Comfortable being the translator between a data/analytics question and a payments/financial one—most accounts touch both, often in the same conversation

\- A clear, concise writer who simplifies complex things instead of complicating simple ones

\- Obsessively organized, with the kind of follow\-through that catches what everyone else missed

\- Genuinely curious about the Creator Economy—how creators actually make money across platforms, not just how they get paid

**Nice to have**

\- Experience with creator or content analytics, multi\-channel network (MCN) tools, or platform monetization systems (YouTube or otherwise)

\- Experience in payments, fintech, or financial operations

\- Time spent in the Creator Economy—platform, agency, brand, or enterprise side

\- Startup experience where you had to build the process, not just follow one

**The fine print**

\- Based in the SF Bay Area or Los Angeles, available to come into the office regularly

\- Authorized to work in the US—we can't sponsor visas or support relocation for this role

\- Comfortable demonstrating your AI workflow as part of the interview process

**What success looks like**

Meet the Team
  
  

The Financial Health team helps Cisco plan spending, manage budgets, and use resources effectively. Our work includes budgeting, forecasting, following financial policies, and automating routine tasks. We partner with Finance and Marketing to turn financial data into clear information that supports business decisions. Our team works together to maintain accurate financial records and improve how work gets done. Joining this team gives you the opportunity to help Cisco improve financial planning and support business growth.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

Track operating costs and spending on long\-term assets against approved budgets so budget owners can identify and address differences. Support monthly and quarterly financial reviews by processing purchase requests and invoices, recording costs incurred but not yet billed, and checking that purchasing records match accounting records. Maintain employee count, spending, and forecast data in Hyperion, and explain differences between planned and actual results. Prepare reports that help Finance and Marketing partners understand spending trends, update forecasts, and decide where to take action. Improve recurring financial processes to reduce manual work and errors, with success measured by accurate records, reports delivered on schedule, and completion of required financial checks.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD degree in in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or coursework in finance, accounting, or statistics.
* 3\+ years of experience in business operations, financial analysis, or a role that includes budget tracking and financial reporting.

* Experience completing monthly or quarterly financial reporting activities, including comparing actual spending with budgets, updating forecasts, and checking purchasing records against accounting records.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
### **About The Role**



Together AI is the AI native cloud, which has been built bottoms up to cater to the demand for the new generation of AI applications and agents. The company has seen tremendous growth with 10X growth year on year and has over a million developers.



As we continue to scale the company, we continue to see strong community engagement \- with developers looking at Together AI not just as an inference platform but also as a go\-to place for all things related to open source AI.This newly created role will lead the charter for community engagement, being the advocate for our technical audience and making sure they get what they need to successful, whether they are current users or prospective customers. They will own our X, LinkedIn and Discord channels, and set the strategy for community engagement and growth. They will work across technical teams internally to develop content and other materials to deliver on that strategy.


### **Responsibilities**


* Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community \- understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
* Operate our community handles across X, Linkedin and Discord
* Own content strategy for these handles, delivering engaging content that the community cares about, across learning content, user content and more
* Collaborate across marketing, developer relations and solution architect teams to deliver on the content strategy
* Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community \- including new content types, competitions and swag
* While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in\-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ Dev\-rel teams

### **Requirements**


* 3\+ years of developer marketing and community engagement experience
* Deep understanding of the AI developer audience
* Keenly aware of social spaces that developers operate in, and ideally, they themselves operate in those spaces on X
* Naturally inclined towards social presence, always keeping a pulse on what’s happening in the developer world
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to build something from ground up
* Data\-driven and ideas person \- always thinking of new experiments and content
* Ideally a developer themselves with an engineering background

### **About Together AI**



Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, reinforcement learning to create specialized models, and pre\-training for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves over 400 trillion tokens a month.


### **Compensation**



We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $200K\-230K \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. This is a hybrid role based in the Bay Area.


### **Equal Opportunity**



Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.



Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.description:
**Social Media Manager**

**About Us...**

Tri Valley Plastic Surgery is a leading plastic surgery and med spa practice in the Bay Area. We deliver outstanding patient outcomes in a warm, professional environment. Producing compelling brand\-aligned social media is critical for connecting with our patients and greater Bay Area community.

We’re not just looking for someone to post content. We’re looking for someone who understands aesthetic branding, is passionate about the medical aesthetics space, stays up to date on social media best practices and can communicate trust, expertise, and warmth through powerful digital storytelling.

**Role Overview:**

We're seeking a **strategic and creative content creator** who can develop high\-impact, authentic content to build engagement, strengthen brand visibility, and drive new patient interest through organic social media.

You’ll work closely with our team to capture **behind\-the\-scenes moments**, patient journeys, treatment highlights, and our providers’ personalities, turning them into content that’s engaging, trust\-building, and on\-brand.

You'll also nurture our community with best practice engagement strategies, building strong connections and ensuring a top\-tier customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Content Creation:** Capture and edit high\-quality short\-form videos (Reels, TikToks, Stories, YouTube Shorts), photos, and branded visuals for all major platforms.
* **Authentic Storytelling:** Humanize our brand by showcasing providers, team culture, and real patient experiences.
* **Influencer Strategy:** Identify and collaborate with relevant influencers or UGC creators to expand reach and credibility.
* **Engagement \& Community Management:** Monitor DMs/comments, engage with our audience, and maintain a responsive, friendly brand voice.
* **Trend Research:** Stay current on platform changes, viral trends, and industry innovations in beauty/medical aesthetics.
* **Content Performance Tracking:** Use insights and metrics (engagement, reach, conversions, watch time) to make recommendations and improvements.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work alongside our marketing and medical team to align content with brand goals and growth targets.

**You Are:**

* Passionate about aesthetics, plastic surgery, or luxury beauty
* A self\-starter who can pitch ideas, stay organized, and manage projects independently
* A skilled storyteller with a clean, high\-end visual style
* Comfortable in clinical environments with patients and medical staff
* Professional, punctual, and committed to brand excellence

**Required Qualifications:**

* **2\+ years** of content creation experience (Reels, TikTok, short\-form video)
* Strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms
* Proficient in tools like CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience scouting, briefing, and managing influencer partnerships through formal brand safety vetting.

* Familiarity with educator culture, classroom dynamics, and education social trends.
* Ability to synthesize social metrics and sentiment data into actionable insights for creative iteration and executive reporting.
* Passion for generative AI tools and the ability to translate technical features into teacher solutions.

**About the job**
-----------------


The educators marketing team is dedicated to empowering teachers and learning communities worldwide by connecting them with Google’s ecosystem of education and AI tools. We are seeking a creative, culturally attuned, and strategic social professional to manage the launch, growth, and ongoing strategy of the dedicated Google for Education channel, and scale out and think about the right content across our other social channels.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Hybrid, Sunnyvale)
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 **About the Role:**


CrowdStrike is looking for an Executive Assistant to support three VP\-level leaders across our global Engineering organization. This role provides administrative and operational support in a fast\-paced environment, partnering closely with Engineering teams and cross\-functional groups to keep leaders and their organizations running smoothly.


This is a hybrid role based in Sunnyvale, CA or Redmond, WA. Onsite presence of 2 days per week is required, with additional in\-office attendance to support executive meetings, onsites, and team events.

**What You'll Do:**

**Calendar and Meeting Management**

* Manage complex, high\-volume calendars in Google calendar across multiple time zones, resolving conflicts and reprioritizing as business needs shift sometimes without direction.
* Coordinate leadership team meetings, staff meetings, and department all\-hands — including agenda distribution, materials prep, notes, and action\-item follow\-up
* Follow up to ensure commitments and deliverables are met by others across the org

**Travel and Expense**

* Book and manage domestic and international travel, proactively adjusting for schedule changes and disruptions
* Brief leaders on relevant travel considerations — visas, currency, weather, and local logistics — and coordinate with Global Security on advisories where applicable
* Complete accurate, timely expense reconciliation and reporting in line with company policy
* Serve as an approval delegate for travel requests and expense reports on behalf of supported executives, applying company travel and expense policy and escalating exceptions or out\-of\-policy items to the executive or manager

**Events and Program Coordination**

* Plan and organize group activities and events for up to \~60 attendees without additional support, identifying who will do what and when, and monitoring progress and resource use
* Track meeting budgets, following approval workflows and coordinating with procurement teams, catering, activities, and travel logistics
* Coordinate logistics for recurring talent programs — annual performance review and mid\-year promotion cycles — including scheduling review sessions, communicating deadlines, and tracking documentation completeness in partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition

**Operational Support and Partnership**

* Take personal responsibility, with guidance from your manager, for well\-defined recurring projects such as weekly status reporting and onsite planning
* Identify and act on issues within your area of responsibility rather than waiting for escalation; try varied approaches and persist when difficulties arise
* Surface process friction points and improvement ideas to your manager and the broader EA team
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with EA peers, Engineering leaders, and cross\-functional partners; navigate ambiguity and help resolve scheduling and prioritization conflicts across teams
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with consistent discretion and sound judgment

**What You'll Need:**

* 2\+ years of executive administrative support experience, including direct support of senior leaders (Director level or above), or equivalent combination of experience and education
* Demonstrated experience booking and managing complex domestic and international travel, including multi\-leg itineraries, visa and documentation requirements, and real\-time rebooking during disruptions
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, high\-volume calendars across multiple time zones for multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with Google Workspace — Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive — is required
* Proficiency with Zoom and Slack is required
* Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in your workflow — for example, drafting and editing communications, summarizing meetings and documents, researching travel and logistics, or preparing briefing materials — and enthusiasm for adopting new AI tooling as it becomes available
* Experience acting as an approval delegate for travel and expense workflows, with working knowledge of T\&E policy
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
* Exceptional attention to detail — reviews all relevant information before acting and proactively seeks review of your own work
* Proven ability to plan and coordinate group events and meetings independently
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and proprietary information
* Ability to work onsite in Sunnyvale, CA or Redmond, WA on a hybrid schedule
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically with advance notice to support leader

jobs.description:
#### **Registered Nurse (RN) – Street Medicine/Portable Care Program Coordinator**


Organization: North Jersey Community Research Initiative (NJCRI)



Work Location: In Person


#### **Position Summary**


NJCRI is seeking an experienced, independent, and highly motivated Registered Nurse (RN) to serve as the Street Medicine/Portable Care Program Coordinator.



The RN Program Coordinator provides clinical and operational leadership for NJCRI’s mobile and community\-based healthcare services for individuals experiencing homelessness and other underserved populations. This position combines direct nursing care, program management, community outreach, staff supervision, quality oversight, and partnership development.



The Program Coordinator directly supervises the program’s Community Health Worker (CHW), Case Manager, and Medical Assistant and is responsible for coordinating the team’s daily activities, outreach assignments, documentation, performance, and delivery of high\-quality, patient\-centered services.



The ideal candidate will have experience in addiction nursing, harm reduction, community health, infectious disease, or healthcare for underserved populations, along with demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills. The RN Program Coordinator must be comfortable providing services in nontraditional healthcare settings, including shelters, community locations, encampments, and mobile outreach environments.



Clinical Services \& Direct Patient Care



Provide nursing services in community\-based settings, including shelters, encampments, outreach locations, and mobile health settings.



Coordinate and participate in street outreach, mobile health services, and community engagement activities.



Conduct HIV, viral hepatitis, and sexually transmitted infection (STI) testing, counseling, education, and linkage to treatment.



Perform phlebotomy and specimen collection for laboratory testing.



Conduct health screenings and point\-of\-care testing, including blood pressure, blood glucose, cholesterol, pregnancy testing, and other appropriate assessments.



Review laboratory results and coordinate appropriate follow\-up with patients and healthcare providers.



Provide wound assessment, treatment, education, and ongoing wound care management within the RN scope of practice and established clinical protocols.



Administer vaccinations, medications, and other preventive health services as authorized and within scope of practice.



Provide overdose prevention and harm\-reduction education and facilitate access to Naloxone.



Assess patients for acute and chronic health concerns and coordinate appropriate clinical intervention, escalation, or referral.



Coordinate referrals and linkage to primary care, infectious disease care, behavioral health services, substance use disorder treatment, social services, housing resources, and other supportive services.



Facilitate pregnancy testing and referrals for prenatal and reproductive healthcare services.



Monitor patient progress and support successful linkage to and retention in healthcare services.


#### **Leadership \& Staff Supervision**


Provide direct supervision and day\-to\-day oversight of the Community Health Worker, Case Manager, and Medical Assistant assigned to the program.



Establish clear staff responsibilities, assignments, priorities, and performance expectations.



Coordinate staff schedules and outreach assignments to ensure appropriate coverage for mobile and community\-based services.



Conduct regular team meetings and individual supervision to review program activities, patient needs, barriers to care, and follow\-up responsibilities.



Monitor staff performance, productivity, documentation, attendance, and completion of assigned responsibilities.



Provide coaching, training, and ongoing guidance to support staff development and adherence to program and clinical standards.



Ensure staff complete required documentation, data entry, outreach records, referrals, and follow\-up activities accurately and within established timeframes.



Address performance or operational concerns promptly and collaborate with NJCRI leadership and Human Resources when additional support or corrective action is necessary.



Identify staff training needs and coordinate appropriate education and professional development.



Promote effective communication and collaboration among clinical, outreach, case management, and support staff.



Foster a professional, respectful, accountable, and patient\-centered team environment.


#### **Program Management \& Operations**


Manage and coordinate the day\-to\-day operations of the Street Medicine/Portable Care Program, including clinical workflows, outreach activities, staffing, and service delivery.



Develop, implement, and evaluate program policies, procedures, workflows, and quality improvement initiatives.



Ensure services are delivered in accordance with NJCRI policies and applicable federal, state, local, clinical, regulatory, and grant requirements.



Monitor program performance, service utilization, quality indicators, and outcomes to ensure achievement of agency and grant objectives.



Identify clinical and operational barriers and work collaboratively with leadership to develop and implement solutions.



Ensure accurate and timely clinical documentation, case notes, and data entry within the electronic health record and required reporting systems.



Prepare and submit required monthly, quarterly, annual, and grant\-related reports accurately and within established deadlines.



Collect and evaluate patient feedback and satisfaction information to identify opportunities for program improvement.



Maintain appropriate clinical and outreach supplies and communicate supply or equipment needs to management.



Collaborate with NJCRI clinical, behavioral health, outreach, case management, and administrative teams to promote continuity of care.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Department of Social Services (DSS) is comprised of the administrative units of the New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) and the Department of Homeless Services (DHS). HRA is dedicated to fighting poverty and income inequality by providing New Yorkers in need with essential benefits such as Food Assistance and Emergency Rental Assistance. DHS is committed to preventing and addressing homelessness in New York City by employing a variety of innovative strategies to help families and individuals successfully exit shelter and return to self\-sufficiency as quickly as possible.
  

  

The Office of the Ombudsman provides independent and impartial assistance to OHS clients and provides the public with access to a wide array of information and services.
  

  

The DSS Ombudsman staff responds to constituent concerns and inquiries. The Ombudsman Office is the point of intake for all DHS shelter concerns received via the HRA intake line, and the staff routes inquiries to the appropriate division or provider. In addition, Ombudsman addresses concerns from shelter residents that are not related to facility conditions. All of these inquiries are tracked in the Intranet Quorum (IQ) system for reporting purposes.
  

  

The Community Coordinator will report to the Ombudsman Deputy Director and provide effective conflict resolution; ensure fair and equal access to DHS, City, and community\-based services and resources; and maintain a comprehensive data tracking and reporting system. The Community Coordinator will actively engage constituents in a meaningful manner and empower them to participate in decisions that affect their lives. The Community Coordinator will visit shelters to meet with shelter management and residents and conduct presentations regarding what the Office of the Ombudsman can help them with.

* Provide supportive client experience through effective and compassionate listening and timely client\-focused case management. Provide direct counseling and/or outreach services. Refer to other public agencies or community resources as needed.

  

* Maintain records detailing and tracking ongoing and completed cases/activities in Intranet Quorum (IQ). Generate reports designed to detail and/or aggregate activities on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis to identify shelter concerns and complaints. * Develop, strengthens, and maintain rapport with internal and external partners to support the needs of constituents. Develop and maintains knowledge base of resources, which support the needs of constituents.

If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.


**Event Operations Coordinator \| The Mallory, NYC**

  


**About The Mallory:**



The Mallory is Convene Hospitality Group's premier new event destination located within the historic Terminal Warehouse in West Chelsea, New York. Reimagined from a landmark 19th\-century freight hub into a dynamic 50,000\-square\-foot venue, The Mallory blends original industrial architecture with modern design and technology to host everything from galas and fashion shows to weddings and private celebrations for up to 550 guests. We are building a hospitality\-oriented team dedicated to delivering thoughtful, high\-touch experiences for every client and guest who step through our doors. Learn more about our space at: https://www.themallorynyc.com.

  


**About The Role:**



As we continue building our opening team, we are seeking an Event Operations Coordinator to support the end\-to\-end execution of all meetings and events, both internal and external, serving as a vital bridge between the planning phase and on\-the\-floor operations. Reporting to the Senior Event Producer, this role provides high\-level administrative and tactical support to the Event Production team to ensure seamless event delivery. This is a full\-time hourly position that requires flexibility for early morning, evening, and weekend event coverage.


**Event Support \& Production Coordination:**


* Support the Event Producers in the end\-to\-end execution of meetings and events.
* Coordinate event logistics including but not limited to load\-in/load\-out, freight, security, vendor meals, and vendor arrivals.
* Place and manage vendor orders including but not limited to rentals, entertainment services, marketing materials, catering, etc.,

* Assist with site tours and execute "Surprise \& Delight" moments for clients.


**On\-Site Execution \& Fringe Hour Coverage:**


* Provide on\-the\-floor support during peak event times and fringe hours (early mornings/late evenings).
* Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients on event days, ensuring all culinary, service, AV, and vendor needs are met.

**Operations \& Administrative Coordination:**

Power Pilates is the leading educator of classical Pilates in the world, with a network of 200\+ training centers in 20\+ countries supported by more than 25,000 Power Pilates trained graduates since 1995\. Power Pilates is distinguished in the industry by an unwavering emphasis on training that honors the integrity of the original method developed by Joseph Pilates.

Our programs provide wide accessibility to communities worldwide through a broad teacher and student network, prestigious resources, and a systematic, comprehensive and integrative approach to Pilates training. Power Pilates education programs give graduates the tools and confidence to instruct clients through workouts that transform the body from the inside out, providing noticeable improvements in posture, strength, stamina, flexibility and an overall sense of wellness.

Power Pilates is dedicated to fostering education programs, studios and a workplace where every client and staffer is valued and feels a genuine sense of belonging.

**The Role**

The Client Experience Specialist is the person who makes sure a first\-time client becomes a regular. You'll run the front desk during your shift, but the heart of the job is the follow\-through: reaching out after intro classes, helping clients pick the right package, welcoming back people we haven't seen in a while, and keeping our studios looking the way a classical Pilates studio should. You'll also be the go\-to teammate who shows new front desk agents how we do things.

This is a senior individual\-contributor role. You report to the Operations Coordinator; you won't manage other staff.

**What you'll do**

* Deliver a warm, polished check\-in and sales experience for every client, in person, by phone and by email

* Ask happy clients for Google/Yelp reviews and flag any concerns to the Manager the same day

* Open and/or close the studio as a trusted key holder

* Own the twice\-weekly inventory count and supply list for your studio
* Train new Front Desk Sales Agents on check\-in, sales scripts, checklist standards and Mindbody
* Pull simple weekly numbers (intros, conversions, outreach sent) for the Manager

**You are**

* Experienced: 2\+ years at a fitness, spa or hospitality front desk, ideally with sales results you can talk about
* Fluent in Mindbody (or similar club/spa software) and comfortable in MS Office and Google Workspace
* A clear, professional writer \- email and text are half of this job

* Confident with Instagram and Facebook
* Someone with a positive attitude, a great sense of personal style, and a real love of fitness \- Pilates experience is a plus

You will produce and orchestrate authentic, relatable, peer\-to\-peer short\-form video content that demystifies AI, showcases practical time\-saving classroom hacks, and drives teacher advocacy and product adoption globally.


As the Social Lead on the educators marketing team, you will serve as the primary brand storyteller and short\-form video strategist, driving organic audience growth, community engagement, and creator partnerships across our Google for Education (GfE) social channels. In this role, you will direct end\-to\-end content development, social editorial planning, and agency collaboration to translate product innovations into authentic, creator\-first short\-form video campaigns. Operating as our dedicated Social Lead, you will execute full\-funnel social marketing strategies that enhance brand favorability, cultivate peer\-to\-peer advocacy, and turn emerging cultural trends into measurable community adoption.


Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems\-from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. **About** **monday.com**
========================


monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

  

**About the Role**
==================


We’re looking for a highly motivated Sales Development Representative to play a pivotal role in generating qualified leads and building a robust pipeline for our sales team. You’ll be responsible for proactively reaching out to ideal prospects, qualifying their needs and pain points, and setting valuable appointments with the Account Executives team. This is a results\-oriented position where your proactive and creative/strategic approach, excellent communication skills, and industry knowledge will be key to your success.

* **Open doors.** Take a data\-driven approach to prospecting that builds a pipeline across key customer segments, while building connections and establishing monday.com's brand in markets we will be entering soon.
* **Take extreme ownership.** Identify and actively address inefficiencies: we need to leverage our tools for prospecting at speed
* **Qualification:** Conduct deep\-dive discovery calls to understand prospect needs, challenges, and budget. Uncover potential buying signals and pain points to determine fit with our solutions.
* **Meeting preparation:** Prepare detailed call reports and qualification summaries for AEs, including key contact information, company background, and potential deal size.
* **CRM management:** Accurately and consistently update CRM with prospect data, call notes, and meeting outcomes.
* **Reporting and analysis:** Track and analyze your activity and performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and share insights with management.
* **Continual learning:** Stay updated on industry trends, competitor landscape, and company offerings to effectively engage and qualify prospects.

**Requirements**
================

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Outbound sales and/or lead generation
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and engage prospects in meaningful conversations.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills, adapt at multitasking and prioritizing effectively.
* Proficient in CRM software and data analysis tools (preferably Salesforce)
* Passion for learning and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Competitive spirit and drive to exceed quota and win deals. Self\-starter, goal oriented
* Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com solution and connect that knowledge directly to customer ROI
* Develop strategies and coordinate cross\-functional support to help customers maximize the value from the monday.com solutions
* Proven ability to identify and overcome sales objections.
* Self\-starter, goal\-orientated, and customer\-centric

**What** **monday.com** **can offer you:**

* Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall.
* Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide
* Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people who build the product should share in its success
* Grow fast through a dedicated L\&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons \- the industry moves quick and so do we
* A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

  

The estimated annual base salary range for this role is $75,000 \- $85,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including education, training, experience, business needs, and work location. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for either an annual discretionary bonus or a role\-based, sales incentive plan. Certain roles may also include equity in the form of RSUs. Full compensation details, including any applicable bonus or incentive plan, will be provided in the hiring process.


monday.com offers a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive medical/dental/vision insurance, generous paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal leave and sick leave), fully paid parental leave, automatic 401(k) contributions, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount (ESPP), and more. jobs.description:
**About Hypercore**

**Hypercore** is building the operating system for the **$3T\+ global Private Credit market** \- one of the fastest\-growing and most under\-served asset classes in finance.


Backed by **Insight Partners**, **Y Combinator and ATINC**, Hypercore is trusted by leading private credit funds, BDCs, and alternative asset managers to run their most mission\-critical operations. As private credit firms scale in size and complexity, legacy systems and spreadsheets are no longer sufficient \- and that’s exactly where Hypercore comes in.


We sell into sophisticated, high\-stakes environments where the cost of error is real and the value of getting it right is enormous. Our buyers are senior leaders across **Finance, Operations, Portfolio Management, and Technology**, and our deals reflect true enterprise complexity and impact.


Hypercore is scaling fast \- not just in revenue, but in ambition. We’re building a category\-defining company in a massive market, and we’re assembling a sales organization that wants to grow with it.

**Job Description**


Hypercore is looking for a driven **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. This pivotal role is essential to fueling our sales pipeline by identifying and engaging with potential customers through strategic outbound efforts. We're seeking someone who can combine deep knowledge of lending operations and financial technology with excellent communication skills to engage and drive decision\-makers in the lending industry to explore our solution.


As an SDR at Hypercore, you will be the first touchpoint for prospects, carefully qualifying leads based on predefined criteria and setting up meetings for the CEO to close. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your enterprise sales skills while working with cutting\-edge technology in the lending space.

**Responsibilities**

* **Lead Generation \& Qualification:** Identify, engage, and qualify potential leads through research and outreach, ensuring only high\-potential opportunities reach the CEO.
* **Data\-Driven Pipeline Management:** Use analytics to measure performance, maintain detailed interaction records, and collaborate with founders to refine targeting strategies and improve conversion rates.
* **Strategic Execution:** Coordinate qualified meetings, manage follow\-ups, maintain CRM records, and adapt strategies based on market feedback and industry trends.
* **Cross\-functional Excellence:** Work with marketing to align messaging, while leveraging industry knowledge and emerging technology trends to improve outreach effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* **Drive:** Highly motivated with a strong desire to contribute to the company’s growth and success.
* **Proven Success:** Demonstrated ability to generate and qualify leads, meeting performance goals in a data\-driven sales environment.
* **Experience:** 2\-3 years of experience in sales development or enterprise sales, particularly in SaaS or technology\-focused industries. Experience in niche sectors, including FinTech, is a plus.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles and familiarity with technology adoption in B2B financial services environments.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling outreach messages and build relationships with key decision\-makers.
* **Analytical Skills:** Experience using data to assess and improve outreach strategies, with proficiency in CRM and sales tools.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to pivot quickly in response to changes in industry trends, feedback, and market dynamics.

**Why Hypercore?**

* Join a start\-up with an incredibly fun and exciting culture, backed by leading investors.
* Amazing opportunity for professional growth. Young company, allowing you to be empowered and trusted to make impactful decisions and think strategically.
* Attractive compensation package including early\-stage equity/stock options
* Flexible working arrangements

**Compensation, Benefits \& Perks**

* **Competitive compensation:** $60K–$65K base \+ uncapped commission (OTE: $90K–$100K)
* **Equity:** Early\-stage stock options, giving you the opportunity to share in Hypercore’s success
* **Health coverage:** Fully paid health insurance for you and your spouse
* **Paid time off:** 20 days of PTO plus 7 days of paid sick leave annually
* **Retirement benefits:** Access to a 401(k) plan
* Monthly **meal allowance** and **commuter benefits**


If you possess these qualities and are excited about the opportunity to join an early\-stage startup and make a significant impact on its success, we encourage you to apply.


Compensation Range: $60K \- $65K

Project Coordinator \- Architectural Designer
