This position reports to the Program Manager – Design Team and Director of DEAM’s Technical Services.


The Project Coordinator will be responsible for providing timely and accurate design coordination tasks including (but not limited to) sales quote support, renderings, technical design, product design support and development, and coordination support between the sales, concept design, and technical design between teams in the City of Atlanta Area. Entry level position and works under general supervision from division head and other senior level Architectural Designers.

* Project management and scheduling of design, collateral, and rendering concept design.
* Check technical drawings and specifications for accuracy and coordinate with Architectural designers to execute and update.
* Rendering development and execution of office furniture and space planning in support of Architectural Designers.
* Competent in 2D and 3D design, and the ability to make photo\-realistic renderings efficiently and under time constraints used for web, print and client presentations.

* Develop standard operating procedures and best practices.

* Demonstrated desire to expand skills into new areas.
* Proficiency in VRay, Sketchup, Revit, AUTOCAD, Adobe Creative Cloud Photoshop
* Business acumen in areas of customer service, e\-commerce, retail, logistics or sales support is advantageous.
* Experience in and an eye for process improvement.

Description:
### **Are you passionate about empowering youth and coordinating programs that create lasting impact? Do you enjoy building community partnerships and supporting vulnerable populations through evidence\-based services?** **If you answered YES, then consider joining our Devereux team!**

### **Being a Project Coordinator at Devereux has its Advantages:** **You will work with other dedicated professionals who share your passion for helping individuals in need. We offer:**

* A collaborative and mission\-driven work environment
* The opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of at\-risk youth
* Professional growth and development opportunities
* The ability to build community partnerships and lead impactful programming
* Competitive compensation based on education and experience

### **Position Summary:** **As a** **Project Coordinator****, you will oversee the implementation of youth development, mentoring, foster care support, healthy relationship education, and prevention initiatives. You will coordinate program activities, engage youth participants, build partnerships with community stakeholders, support mentors and volunteers, and ensure services are delivered using trauma\-informed and survivor\-centered practices.** **Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee youth development and prevention programming across multiple program locations
* Facilitate healthy relationship education, life skills training, empowerment workshops, and enrichment activities
* Develop positive, supportive relationships with youth participants and assist with individualized support planning
* Coordinate mentoring services and monitor participant engagement and progress
* Collaborate with internal teams and community partners including schools, foster care agencies, residential programs, and other stakeholders
* Support youth involved in foster care, residential treatment, juvenile justice systems, or those at risk of trafficking and exploitation
* Facilitate prevention and awareness activities related to healthy relationships, internet safety, and exploitation prevention
* Recruit, engage, and support volunteers, mentors, and community supporters
* Maintain accurate participant records, track program outcomes, and monitor performance indicators
* Assist with grant reporting, data collection requirements, and preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
* Ensure compliance with agency policies, grant requirements, confidentiality standards, and trauma\-informed practices
* Represent Devereux and the Love Notes Project at community meetings, outreach events, and networking opportunities
* Participate in required trainings, staff meetings, and professional development activities
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned

### **If** **youth empowerment, community engagement, and program coordination** **are your passion, you'll enjoy this opportunity to make a meaningful impact.** **Here's your chance to help young people build healthy relationships, develop life skills, and achieve brighter futures.**

  

Devereux Advanced Behavioral Health GA provides programs and services for adolescents with behavioral and developmental diagnoses.

Devereux has a zero\-tolerance policy for abuse and maintains policies and procedures to systematically reduce the risk of abuse to occur in our organization. Devereux fosters a culture of reporting abuse, and will cooperate with the authorities to the fullest extent possible.

jobs.title: Special Education Compliance Program Coordinator - Georgia Connections Academy
jobs.description:
**School Summary**

Georgia Connections Academy is a tuition\-free, full\-time virtual school for students in grades K\-12 throughout Georgia. The school is authorized by the Georgia Charter Schools Commission and governed by an independent Board of Directors, with a mission to maximize academic achievement for students who are seeking other academic options. The school is operated by Georgia Connections Academy, a nonprofit corporation, through a contract with Connections Academy of Georgia, LLC, to provide its educational program and other services. Connections Academy, a division of Connections Education, is accredited by AdvancED, and GACA is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges \& Schools Council on Accreditation and School Improvement.


*Georgia Connections Academy strives to create an inclusive environment that welcomes and values the diversity of the people we serve. We foster fairness, equity, and inclusion to create a workplace environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.*

**Position Summary**

Working from the Duluth, Georgia, office and from your home office within Georgia, certified teachers at Georgia Connections Academy support and motivate students through high\-quality virtual instruction using the Pearson Online Classroom. Teachers deliver synchronous and asynchronous instruction, provide intervention and enrichment, engage families, and use data to drive student learning and growth.



All GACA teachers and staff must be able to regularly participate in required in\-person activities that may require overnight travel throughout the state of Georgia, including but not limited to:


* School and department meetings
* Student engagement events
* Professional development and required training
* State testing, Diagnostic testing, and all in\-person summative and formative assessments
* Graduation and other school\-level events


Staff may also be required to support virtual administration of assessments, as scheduled by the school.


**Position Overview:**

Working from the Duluth office, the Program Coordinator of Special Education Compliance will be key in organizing and managing new teacher orientation, overseeing mentoring programs, and providing ongoing support to educators throughout the year. Additionally, this position will assist the Director of Special Education with special education compliance, special education instruction, communications, and data management. The Program Coordinator will assist in the management of the Special Education Department and will be a point of contact for families of students with disabilities. The Program Coordinator of Special Education will be an expert in Federal and State Special Education regulations.



This is a 12\-month, full\-time position.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Oversee Special Education Compliance Data;
* Assist the Special Education Leadership Team with audit reviews;
* Support professional development activities for case managers, teachers and school staff members;
* Manage and supervise special education case managers;
* Understand the requirements for and assist the state testing team to facilitate the administration of all district testing;
* Assist Special Education Leadership Team with the enrollment process including requesting appropriate paperwork and assuring all documents needed are obtained;
* Assist teachers when students enroll mid\-semester, making sure that teachers and case managers receive guidance on special education supports and services;
* Assist with the hiring and onboarding process of special education teachers and case managers;
* Assist with GO IEP organization and management, including onboarding and exiting students from platform, assisting with resolving support tickets, running regular compliance reports with follow up actions
* Other duties as assigned.


**Assessment \& Accountability**


* Administer formative and summative assessments, including monthly progress monitoring, CFAs, EOGs and EOCs where applicable.
* Participate in all required Georgia state standardized assessments in\-person and virtual sessions, including Georgia Milestones, ACCESS, Georgia Alternative Assessment, etc., in addition to End\-of\-Pathway, benchmarks, CFAs, and diagnostic assessments.
* Maintain accurate records of attendance, communication logs, academic progress, and intervention documentation.


**Collaboration \& Professional Practice**


* Work collaboratively within the Professional Learning Community to monitor data, plan instruction, and ensure student success.
* Partner with Advisory Teachers, School Counselors, Special Education staff, and team members to meet student needs and ensure strong communication loops.
* Support social, engagement, and community\-building activities—both virtual and in\-person—to cultivate belonging for students and families.
* Attend required school and district professional development and pursue ongoing growth in instructional practice.


**Community Engagement \& School Support**


* Assist in the organization and facilitation of school\-wide events (graduation, field trips, engagement activities).
* Participate in student recruitment efforts, marketing events, and family orientations as needed.
* Support the creation of a positive, inclusive virtual school culture through consistent communication, engagement, and community\-building practices.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support school operations, strategic initiatives, and student success.


**Essential Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong commitment to equitable practice, high expectations, and individualized student support
* Ability to use data to inform instruction and intervention
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* Effective collaboration within virtual and in\-person teams
* Strong organizational skills and timely completion of all required documentation
* Comfort with technology\-based instruction and virtual learning tools

jobs.title: OCIP Workers Compensation Program Coordinator, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

 **Job Title: Safety Administrative Coordinator**

 **Job Summary:** Responsible for providing administrative training, reporting, and operational support to the Corporate Safety Department. This position plays an important role in maintaining accurate safety and training records, coordinating safety\-related programs and activities, supporting reporting requirements, and promoting consistency across the department. The overall goal of the Safety Administrative Coordinator is to be highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable working with technology and data, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced construction environment. This position reports to the Corporate Safety Director and works closely with Safety team members, Human Resources, Operations, and employees throughout the organization.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**



The Safety Administrative Coordinator will include the following:


* Maintain accurate employee safety training records, certifications, and related documentation.
* Enter, update, and audit training information within the Company's learning management and/or safety systems.
* Assist employees and managers with training access, completion, and technical issues.
* Coordinate and assist with scheduling safety training sessions, meetings, orientations, and other safety\-related programs.
* Track required training and certifications and identify upcoming expirations, incomplete training, or other compliance gaps.
* Prepare training rosters, materials, reports, and other documentation as needed.
* Assist with communicating training requirements, deadlines, and program updates to employees and managers.
* Other related duties

  


**Education, Experience, and Licensing/Certifications:**


* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 2–4 years of administrative, coordinator, training, compliance, safety, construction, or related experience preferred.
* Construction industry or safety department experience is a plus but not required

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting a multi\-location organization is preferred.
* Construction industry or safety department experience preferred.
* Experience with safety training or learning management systems.
* Experience maintaining employee training or certification records.
* Experience preparing or auditing reports and operational data.
* Familiarity with MVR administration or fleet/driver compliance.
* Familiarity with asset tracking and distribution.
* Experience working within the construction industry or another safety\-sensitive environment.

  



**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required Include:**


* High level of maturity and judgment; ability to be discreet and maintain confidentiality of information.
* Excellent skills in organization, time management, planning, and prioritization.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Effective communication skills (written and verbal) and presentation skills.
* Professional demeanor and effective interpersonal skills; ability to provide a high level of customer service and successfully interface with and maintain good working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization as well as external parties; ability to foster collaborative relationships.
* Skilled at active listening techniques. Gathers appropriate information before taking action and encourages others to listen and check before acting. Communications are tactful, diplomatic, and influential.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, shifting deadlines, and evolving business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong proficiency with computers and software, to include Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and an ability to use AI appropriately to improve efficiency, reporting, document preparation, research, data organization, and other administrative processes.

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About White Swan Bridal**

White Swan Bridal is a boutique bridal experience focused on personalized styling, thoughtful service, and helping each bride feel confident and seen. We offer a curated selection of gowns with extensive customization options, creating a truly unique experience for every bride.

At White Swan Bridal, we believe every bride deserves a warm, elevated, and unforgettable experience from the moment she walks through our doors.

We are looking for a full\-time **Client Experience Coordinator** to be the welcoming face and voice of our boutique. This role is essential in creating a seamless, organized, and beautiful experience for both our brides and our team, while also supporting our day\-to\-day social media presence.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Client Experience \& Front Desk**

* Greet brides and their guests with warmth and professionalism
* Answer calls, texts, emails, and social media messages with a friendly, helpful tone
* Guide brides through general questions (appointments, timelines, process)
* Manage appointment scheduling, confirmations, and overall flow of the day

**Alterations Coordination**

* Check brides in and out for alterations appointments
* Schedule fittings and manage alterations calendar
* Assist in coordinating communication between brides and alterations specialists
* Support in preparing and communicating alterations quotes alongside the seamstress

**Sales \& Operations Support**

* Process payments and check out brides accurately

* Receive and log incoming inventory
* Communicate with designers and vendors to confirm order details, timelines, and updates
* Verify accuracy between customer orders and vendor requirements
* Follow up on order statuses and ensure clear communication with both vendors and brides
* Help maintain accuracy and organization across all order\-related information
* Print and attach tags to new gowns
* Maintain store cleanliness and presentation throughout the day
* Assist with gown organization and upkeep

**Weekend Support**

* Float between front desk and sales floor
* Reset fitting rooms and assist with dress care
* Help maintain a smooth, elevated experience during busy appointments

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Is**

* Available to work every weekend (Saturdays and Sundays)
* Naturally warm, welcoming, and professional
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Calm and composed in a fast\-paced environment
* A strong communicator (in person, phone, written, and digital)
* Comfortable managing brand communication across social media
* Has an eye for visual presentation and content

**Qualifications**

* Comfortable using computers and technology in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong written communication skills (email, messaging, and social media)

jobs.title: TPS Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Treasury and Payments Solutions (TPS) Event Coordinator manages the execution and operational support of trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events. The role coordinates attendee registration and communications, invitations, meeting and session logistics, rooming lists, shipping and material handling, venues, vendors, production partners, event timelines, project plans, budget tracking, invoicing, contracts, and onsite support.


The role also supports event reporting, participation tracking, meeting management, feedback and lead capture, campaign attribution, and post\-event analytics, using Salesforce and other event technologies where appropriate. Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and internal event partners, the coordinator helps maintain accurate data, enables timely follow\-up, improves event processes, and delivers a consistent participant experience across external client and internal employee events.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Event Execution \& Operations (60%)**

* Manage end\-to\-end execution of trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events.
* Coordinate event logistics, including invitations, attendee registration and communications, agendas and session support, meeting logistics, rooming lists, shipping and material handling, venue coordination, and vendor management.
* Support multiple large\-scale events simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Manage event timelines, project plans, and execution deliverables.
* Serve as onsite support for priority trade shows, conferences, Client Advisory Groups, and employee events.
* Manage event vendors, venues, sponsorship partners, facilitators, and production partners appropriate to each event type.
* Support budget tracking and reconciliation, coordinate invoicing and payment processes, and maintain event\-related contracts and documentation.

**Salesforce, Reporting \& Pipeline Support (25%)**

* Serve as the primary Salesforce resource for applicable external event and conference reporting, while supporting participation and engagement reporting for Client Advisory Groups and employee events.
* Support audience identification, attendee targeting, invitation, registration, and communication processes across client and employee events.
* Partner with event strategy, client advocacy, and business stakeholders to track meeting activity, participant feedback, commitments, and post\-event follow\-up.
* Work with digital marketing and internal partners to maintain dashboards or reporting that measure participation and engagement across event types.
* Track opportunity influence and pipeline generation for applicable external events, and participation, engagement, and follow\-up measures for Client Advisory Groups and employee events.
* Produce post\-event analytics and reporting to support business reviews, Client Advisory Group follow\-up, and employee event assessment.
* Ensure accurate campaign attribution, meeting capture, participation tracking, and feedback documentation processes, as applicable.

**Meeting Management \& Lead Capture (10%)**

* Manage meeting and session scheduling, confirmations, agendas, participant communications, and logistics.
* Oversee lead, feedback, question, and participation capture processes, including the use of Captello and other event technologies as appropriate.
* Ensure meeting, lead, feedback, and participation data is captured accurately and shared appropriately for follow\-up.
* Partner with event strategy and client advocacy stakeholders to maximize client engagement and support effective employee participation.

**Process Improvement \& Team Support (5%)**

* Maintain event playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify opportunities to streamline execution and improve client, guest, and employee participant experiences.
* Support cross\-functional coordination among Sales, Marketing, Product, Leadership, client advocacy, communications, and employee event partners.

**Measurement \& Impact**


Impact will be reflected through reliable execution across trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events; accurate reporting and attribution; timely follow\-up on meetings, leads, feedback, and commitments; effective operational controls; and continuous improvement of participant experiences.

* On\-time completion of event timelines, project plans, logistics, and execution deliverables
* Accuracy of Salesforce campaign attribution, meeting capture, lead and feedback data, participation tracking, dashboards, and post\-event reporting, as applicable
* Effective budget tracking, reconciliation, invoicing, payment processing, contract management, and documentation
* Timely coordination of meeting activity, Client Advisory Group commitments, participant feedback, and post\-event follow\-up
* Consistent use and improvement of event playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures

**Success Profile**

* Exceptional attention to detail while supporting multiple large\-scale events and concurrent priorities
* Strong partnership across Sales, Marketing, Product, Leadership, digital marketing, client advocacy, communications, and employee event teams
* Accurate, timely reporting, campaign management, analytics, meeting capture, lead and feedback

Job Type

Norcross, Georgia

If you are looking for an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience, develop valuable business skills, and make an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you.

**Apply today and start building your career with Blanke Corporation.**

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Norcross, GA 30071

jobs.title: Development Coordinator (Raiser's Edge Expert)
jobs.description:
**High Meadows School and Camp \| Roswell, Georgia**  
**Full\-time \| 12\-month \| 40 hours/week \| Non\-exempt**

Due to an internal promotion, High Meadows School and Camp is seeking a **Development Coordinator** to join our Development team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys organization, data, details, as well as the creative side of coordinating Development events, mailings, invitations, and being the person behind the scenes who helps everything come together.

Working closely with the Director of Development, the Development Coordinator helps keep the day\-to\-day work of Development organized, accurate, and moving forward. From maintaining donor records and processing gifts to supporting fundraising campaigns and coordinating Development events, this person plays an important role in helping High Meadows build and strengthen relationships across our community.

**What You'll Do**

* As resident Raiser’s Edge expert, you will manage and maintain our Raiser’s Edge donor database, keeping constituent, donor, gift, pledge, and prospect information accurate and up to date
* Process gifts, pledges, and recurring contributions and prepare acknowledgments, tax receipts, pledge reminders, and donor correspondence
* Create reports, mailing lists, donor segments, data merges, and giving analyses to support fundraising and stewardship efforts
* Partner with the Finance team to reconcile gifts and maintain accurate Development and financial records
* Keep Development projects, deadlines, calendars, files, procedures, and tracking systems organized
* Coordinate Development mailings and provide administrative and project support for fundraising campaigns, donor stewardship, alumni engagement, and other Development initiatives
* Assist the Director of Development with donor research, meeting preparation, reports, presentations, correspondence, and special projects
* Plan and coordinate Development Department events and donor gatherings in collaboration with the Director of Development and Events Manager, including invitations, guest and donor lists, RSVPs, communications, fundraising or auction records, event details, and post\-event follow\-up
* Work collaboratively with the Events Manager on Development events, with both positions contributing to the planning, coordination, and successful execution of these events
* Collaborate with Marketing \& Communications to help ensure Development information and messaging are accurate, timely, and consistent
* Pitch in on other Development projects and priorities as they arise

**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**

· Are highly organized and genuinely enjoy keeping details straight

· Like working with data, spreadsheets, databases, reports, and systems

· Enjoy coordinating events and seeing the details come together

· Can manage several priorities and deadlines without losing track of the small things

· Take ownership of your work and follow through

· Communicate warmly and professionally with donors, families, volunteers, colleagues, and other members of the School community

· Are comfortable handling confidential donor, family, and financial information with discretion

· Enjoy working independently while also being part of a collaborative team

· Can adjust when priorities change and still keep things moving

· Are willing to jump in, solve problems, and help where needed

**What You'll Bring**

Experience with Raiser’s Edge is required for this position. Experience with Veracross is helpful, as is strong proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel. You should also be comfortable working with donor data, reports, spreadsheets, gift records, and financial information.

We'd also like to see approximately three to five years of relevant experience in areas such as Development/fundraising, database administration, nonprofit or school operations, or administrative support. Prior experience supporting fundraising operations, donor relations, gift processing, Development programs, or Development\-related events strongly preferred.

A bachelor's degree is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Our Development Coordinator is someone people can count on. You'll know the donor data, understand the systems, anticipate deadlines, catch details, and help keep Development initiatives moving throughout the year.

You'll also be comfortable moving between very different kinds of work—perhaps preparing a donor report one day, processing gifts the next, and then working alongside the Director of Development and Events Manager to coordinate an upcoming donor gathering.

Success at High Meadows means being curious, collaborative, dependable, and willing to take initiative. We're looking for someone who wants to understand the School and Camp as a whole, builds positive relationships across departments, and takes pride in the behind\-the\-scenes work that helps Development and the broader High Meadows community succeed.

**A Little About High Meadows**

High Meadows School and Camp is located on 42 wooded acres in Roswell, Georgia, about 30 minutes north of Atlanta. Our campus includes multiple buildings, meadows, forest, and an active barnyard—so working here doesn't always look like working in a traditional office.

High Meadows offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage; school\-paid life and long\-term disability insurance; a 403(b) retirement plan with up to a 4% school match; paid leave; and a tuition discount for children attending High Meadows School.

**Apply**

Please apply via our school website, www.highmeadows.org, About Us, Working at High Meadows, then scroll down to Active Vacancies. Once you click on a vacancy, you click “Apply Now”.

Questions? Email HR Manager Jane Murphy at **jmurphy@highmeadows.org.** If you are selected for the next steps in the process, you will be contacted directly.

*High Meadows School and Camp

* Attends study meetings.
* Orders and maintains equipment and supplies.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **About Us**



Aptitude 8 is the leading HubSpot solutions consultancy for companies with complex CRM operations, advanced tech stacks, and ambitious growth goals. We design and implement CRM, data, automation, and RevOps solutions that unlock revenue performance and operational excellence. You'll join a rapidly scaling team of builders and operators who want to experiment, solve hard problems, and deliver outcomes that matter.



At Aptitude 8, you'll find remote flexibility, 401k, great benefits, meaningful work, growth opportunities, and the chance to shape the future of how companies operate!


### **About The Role**



We are seeking an individual looking to enhance their marketing career in a position that will allow behind\-the\-scenes access to a rapidly growing professional services business. This role is on our Marketing Team, helping position Aptitude 8 as the \#1 technical consulting partner in the HubSpot ecosystem.



In this role, you will work directly with our Demand Gen Manager on tasks spanning copywriting, social media management, event coordination, advertising, and much more. You will have ample opportunity to learn new skills, collaborate across departments, and have a direct impact on the success of our revenue goals.


**A normal day in this role****:** In this role, you will find that each day looks a little different. On a Monday, you might be putting together the next HubSpot User Group event, procuring swag and promotional items for another event, helping to coordinate a partnership co\-marketing initiative, and fleshing out an outline for a tactical eBook. On Tuesday, you might find yourself helping write emails for a lead gen initiative, making updates to our website, throwing together a social media graphic, or asking for status updates from event venues.


### **About You:**



You consider yourself a motivated, curious, independent, and innovative person who is ready to dive head\-first into any challenge. You're not afraid to ask questions, willing to do some digging/be resourceful, and confident enough in your opinions to provide edits, feedback, and ideas. You identify as a marketer, you are well rounded within the marketing function, and you love working and collaborating as a team. Key items of importance are that you are a skilled planner, detail\-oriented, can manage yours and your team's time effectively, and are very organized to keep track of multiple tasks and projects the team is working on. We are a fully remote team, so tech savviness is key.


* 2\+ years of experience in B2B Marketing either in an agency or in a junior role on an in\-house marketing team.
* Incredibly detail oriented, organized, and love making a plan and sticking to it.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**


Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform.


Thrive’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer\-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

**Position Overview**

As an Account Executive on Thrive’s Velocity team, you will drive revenue growth across a high\-volume portfolio of emerging and lower\-complexity accounts through proactive outbound outreach, upsell and cross\-sell selling, and disciplined pipeline management. This role is ideal for a motivated, early\-career sales professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys high activity, and is energized by building relationships, uncovering client needs, and closing transactional opportunities. You will partner closely with internal teams to deliver a strong customer experience while helping clients access the right Thrive solutions to support their business goals.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow a designated portfolio of Velocity accounts through proactive outreach, relationship development, and opportunity identification
* Generate revenue by driving upsell, cross\-sell, and expansion opportunities across Thrive’s solutions and services
* Conduct a high volume of outbound calls, emails, and follow\-up activities to create pipeline and move opportunities forward
* Qualify client needs, identify buying signals, and align Thrive solutions to customer priorities using a consultative sales approach
* Own the sales process for transactional opportunities from initial outreach through quote, proposal, and close
* Maintain accurate account details, activity tracking, pipeline updates, and forecasting within Salesforce and related sales tools
* Partner effectively with internal stakeholders including service delivery, client success, solutions, and operations to support client needs and close business
* Monitor account activity, service trends, and customer feedback to identify retention risks and growth opportunities
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets tied to bookings, activity, and account growth
* Build knowledge of Thrive’s services, value proposition, and key market trends to communicate confidently with clients
* Participate in sales training, coaching, role\-play, and enablement activities to strengthen selling capability and accelerate performance
* Complete required reporting, documentation, and administrative responsibilities with accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications \& Experience:**

* 2\+ years of sales, inside sales, business development, account management, or customer\-facing revenue experience, preferably in technology, managed services, SaaS, or a related industry
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of outreach and sales activity while maintaining strong follow\-up and organization
* Experience generating revenue through upsell, cross\-sell, renewals support, or transactional selling preferred
* Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly articulate value to clients
* Ability to identify opportunities, qualify needs, and advance deals in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven sales environment
* Comfort using CRM tools such as Salesforce to manage pipeline, activity, and account information with discipline and accuracy
* Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to a strong team environment
* Curiosity, coachability, and willingness to learn Thrive’s solutions, sales process, and client needs quickly
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required for candidates with relevant sales experience and a strong track record of performance

**Competencies to be Successful in the Role**

* Drive and Energy: Brings a high level of activity, urgency, and enthusiasm to managing accounts and creating opportunities
* Customer Focus: Builds strong relationships and looks for ways to help clients solve problems and gain value from Thrive’s solutions
* Sales Curiosity: Asks thoughtful questions, listens well, and uncovers underlying client needs and growth opportunities
* Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and confidently across phone, email, and virtual interactions
* Resilience: Stays motivated through rejection, setbacks, and changing priorities in a fast\-paced sales environment
* Organization and Discipline: Maintains strong follow\-up, pipeline hygiene, and attention to detail across a high volume of activity
* Coachability: Responds well to feedback, applies learning quickly, and shows a desire to continuously improve
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams to support clients, solve problems, and move opportunities forward
* Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to new priorities, tools, messaging, and business needs in a growing organization
* Ownership: Takes accountability for results, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates pride in doing the job well

Exclusive licenses with recognizable brands such as DeWalt, Stanley Black \& Decker and Craftsman further strengthens FNA's market presence and awareness. FNA is a dynamic organization with unprecedented growth due largely to its ability to attract and retain highly talented associates.


We have an excellent opportunity for a results\-oriented Associate National Account Manager who can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Job Description:**


As an Associate National Account Manager for FNA Group, you will be responsible for developing and growing key retail partnerships within the company's consumers portfolio. You will support our sales initiatives with our customers in efforts of growing our business. Additionally, you will interface with FNA Group Demand Planning, Marketing, and Product teams in developing selling strategies, launching new products and aligning our forecast in efforts of delivering incremental business for your customers while maintaining targeted volume and profitability levels. The Associate National Account Manager can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Support the National Account Team in developing and executing the annual account strategy and targets.
* Develop relationships with key customer partners across merchant, inventory, and online teams.
* Work cross\-functionally with internal teams to execute new product launches, maintain current listings, and identify opportunities with assortment.
* Master product knowledge for assigned customer.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Find Your Career With LiftOne**

We’re a family\-owned company under our fourth generation of leadership and have built our business based on the principles of trust, integrity and a desire to help our customers and employees succeed.


LiftOne invests in people, facilities and innovative technology as part of the essential role we play in supporting our country’s supply chain and enabling critical goods to be delivered to homes and businesses. We’re a privately held company, and pair our scale with a strong foundation in our culture and values. This combination gives us a competitive advantage in the market and helps make us a trailblazing organization that is built to last.


We’re looking for hard\-working, team\-oriented professionals who enjoy working on new challenges every day. We believe our employees are the key to our success, and we’re committed to providing a work experience that helps our team grow to their full potential. We offer great benefits, competitive salaries and opportunities for advancement to all our employees.


Be a part of the essential work we do at LiftOne and make a difference for our customers, our community and our company. Learn more about what it means to become a team member with LiftOne.

**Summary**


As a LiftOne Account Manager, you will be combining technical knowledge with sales skill to profitably grow revenue for the company and maximize market share. This position requires someone that has a strong technical acumen, is assertive, personable, and solutions\-oriented. In this position, you will identify new sales opportunities and manage a book of assigned business, develop sales proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations. You will prepare strategic plans to increase revenue and position LiftOne as the premier partner for material handling equipment, service programs, preventive maintenance contracts, parts, additional repair programs, rental power programs and rental services. The ability to work with people and teams is essential.

**Essential Functions**

* Strategically identify opportunities to grow sales profitably with new and existing customers within an assigned territory. Develop and execute account plans for existing and potential target accounts.
* Pursues the critical success factors for the application, distribution, and satisfaction of customer needs for material handling equipment and service programs
* Partner with the customer to understand their business and serve as a trusted advisor who understands their needs.
* Develop and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations that explain why a customer should consider a change, why it makes sense now and then why you and CTE are in the unique position to deliver the solutions that will benefit the customer.
* Think critically and suggest improvements that lead to risk mitigation, cost savings, profitable revenue growth or other customer goal achievement.
* Understand and report on significant market trends and competitive intelligence.
* Provide clear and accurate responses for RFPs and contribute technical solutions directly to proposals.
* Identify customer business opportunities by analyzing cost\-benefit ratios of equipment in customer environment; engineering or proposing changes in equipment, processes, or services.
* Develop and calculate finance solutions for varied customer needs or demands.
* Build a strong understanding of customers’ business issues ie: inventory, asset management, ROI, financial statement analysis.
* Maintain and document customer interactions within a CRM and quoting system from first meeting to deal closure and follow\-up activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualifying individuals to perform the essential functions.

**Education and/or Experience**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree or extensive related experience in a technical discipline highly preferred
* Previous work experience with industrial services or technical sales with a documentable track record of successes and accomplishments.
* Strong project management and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills, including verbal, written, listening and presentation skills
* Ability to “think outside the box” to offer new ideas, concepts, solutions etc.
* A desire to build your career. We see this role as a feeder for our future business leaders and you should share that desire.
* Driving is an essential function of this position and a current valid driver’s license must be always maintained.
* **Customer Empathy**\- Develop “loyal” and not just “satisfied” customers – Demonstrate understanding and expertise about our customers through business partnership, integrity, commitment and responsiveness.
* **Be a Team Player**\- Be an “enterprise thinker” when discussing solutions with customers. Predisposition towards prospecting and team selling \- passing leads, intentionally helping teammates, including cross\-functional and departmental networking.
* **Have a Sense of Urgency**– Bias towards action, prioritizing customer needs and service while also achieving constant, forward movement in the sales process.
* **Be a Critical Thinker**\- Leverage our entire product, services and technology portfolio to provide solutions to customers’ problems and create growth accelerators for customers’ businesses.
* **Have Intellectual Curiosity**\- Push yourself on hard and soft skills training and development, continuously. Develop and deliver technically competent, customer facing product walk\-arounds, product demonstrations and sales presentations that align with customer goals, challenges and growth objectives.

Stock ownership plan

jobs.description:
**Laboratory Sales Representative**

**Molecular Infectious Disease Diagnostics**

**Chronetyx Laboratories** is seeking experienced healthcare sales professionals to help expand our growing molecular diagnostics business throughout the Southeast and select Midwest/South Central markets.

**Locations:**  
Nashville, TN

Atlanta, GA

Dallas, TX

St. Louis, MO

Louisville, KY

Cincinnati, OH

**About Chronetyx Laboratories**

Chronetyx Laboratories is a high\-complexity clinical laboratory based in Memphis, Tennessee, focused on providing rapid, accurate, and cost\-effective molecular diagnostic testing.

Our automation\-first laboratory model combines advanced molecular technology, automation, informatics, and streamlined laboratory operations to provide physicians with clinically actionable results and rapid turnaround times.

A major focus of Chronetyx is **molecular infectious\-disease testing**, including pathogen identification and antibiotic\-resistance testing.

**What You Will Sell**

Our growing infectious\-disease testing menu includes:

* **Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) PCR** with reflex antibiotic\-resistance testing
* **Wound and skin/soft\-tissue infection PCR** with antibiotic\-resistance testing
* **Bacterial Vaginosis**
* **Group B Strep**
* **Sexually Transmitted Infection (STI)**
* **Respiratory pathogen testing**
* **Throat/Pharyngitis testing**
* Additional molecular infectious\-disease panels and specialty diagnostic testing

**Position Overview**

The Laboratory Sales Representative will be responsible for developing new physician and healthcare accounts while growing existing relationships within an assigned territory.

This is a **business\-development\-focused sales position**. We are looking for someone who is comfortable prospecting, gaining access to healthcare decision\-makers, presenting laboratory solutions, closing new accounts, and developing long\-term client relationships.

The ideal candidate understands clinical laboratory sales and can effectively communicate the value of accurate molecular testing, antibiotic\-resistance information, turnaround time, specimen logistics, reimbursement, and physician workflow.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop new business for Chronetyx molecular and infectious\-disease laboratory services.
* Identify, prospect, and convert physician practices and healthcare organizations within the assigned territory.
* Build relationships with physicians, administrators, practice managers, nursing leadership, and other healthcare decision\-makers.
* Present and educate clients on UTI PCR testing, Bacterial Vaginosis testing, Group B Strep testing, STI testing, Wound testing, Respiratory testing, Pharyngitis/Strep testing.
* Explain the clinical and operational advantages of molecular pathogen identification compared with traditional C\&S testing approaches.
* Develop and maintain an active pipeline of prospective accounts.
* Conduct regular in\-person sales calls, presentations, lunches, meetings, and follow\-up activities.
* Coordinate with Chronetyx laboratory operations, client services, billing, informatics, and logistics teams to successfully onboard new accounts.
* Maintain detailed sales activity, account information, target lists, forecasts, and next steps.
* Meet or exceed assigned sales activity, revenue, and specimen\-volume goals.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Previous clinical laboratory sales experience is strongly preferred and may be considered a requirement for certain territories.**

We have a particularly strong interest in candidates with prior experience selling:

* Molecular infectious\-disease testing
* PCR\-based laboratory testing
* UTI molecular testing
* Wound infection testing
* Antibiotic\-resistance testing
* Respiratory panels
* STI testing
* Clinical pathology or specialty laboratory services

**Prior infectious\-disease laboratory sales experience is highly desirable.**

Candidates with successful prior experience at companies such as **Eurofins Diatherix, TEN Healthcare, Infinite Genomics, Vikor Scientific, or similar molecular and infectious\-disease laboratories** are strongly encouraged to apply.

An existing network of physician, practice, long\-term care, or healthcare relationships within the assigned territory is a significant advantage.

**Target Customers**

Representatives may call on:

* Urology practices
* Wound\-care centers
* Primary\-care practices
* Urgent\-care centers
* Long\-term care and skilled\-nursing facilities
* Infectious\-disease practices
* Podiatry practices
* OB/GYN and women's health practices
* Multi\-specialty physician groups
* Hospitals and health systems
* Other healthcare organizations with significant infectious\-disease testing needs

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of successful healthcare sales experience preferred.
* Build on your current book of business by adding new client accounts
* Clinical laboratory sales experience strongly preferred.
* Molecular infectious\-disease or PCR sales experience highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to prospect, develop, and close new business.
* Established physician and healthcare relationships within the territory are highly desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare, Biology, Biomedical Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and laboratory reimbursement is preferred.
* Strong communication internal and external, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to understand and communicate clinical and scientific information.
* Proven record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to independently develop a territory.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, and CRM or sales\-management systems.
* Willingness to travel throughout the assigned territory.
* Valid driver's licen

jobs.description:
**Pilgrim Lutheran Church \& School \- Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator**

Pilgrim Lutheran Church \& School is seeking a **mission\-driven, relationship\-focused professional** to serve as our **Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator**. This position is central to growing our school community by helping prospective families discover Pilgrim, guiding them through the enrollment process, and telling the story of what makes our school special.

The Coordinator will lead enrollment and admissions efforts, manage school marketing and communications, and support select fundraising and advancement activities. This is an opportunity for a creative, organized, and people\-oriented professional to make a meaningful impact on the future of a vibrant Lutheran school community.

**Position Snapshot**

* **Schedule:** Approximately 35 hours per week
* **Salary:** $42,000 annually
* **Performance Incentive:** Additional performance bonuses may be available for achieving mutually agreed\-upon enrollment goals.
* **Health Benefits:** Employee\-only medical, dental, and vision benefits
* **Health Opt\-Out:** Additional $2,010 annually, if eligible
* **Retirement:** Employer contribution of 3% of base salary
* **Paid Time Off**

**Key ResponsibilitiesEnrollment \& Admissions**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective families from initial inquiry through enrollment.
* Manage the admissions and enrollment pipeline, including inquiries, applications, follow\-up, and enrollment records.
* Coordinate tours, shadow days, open houses, and other recruitment events.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase inquiries, applications, enrollment, and student retention.
* Build strong, welcoming relationships with prospective and current families.
* Identify opportunities to improve the prospective\-family experience and strengthen enrollment processes.
* Track enrollment trends and use data to identify opportunities for growth.
* Collaborate with school leadership and faculty to showcase Pilgrim's programs, strengths, and student experience.

**Marketing \& Communications**

* Develop and coordinate marketing and communications that promote Pilgrim's mission, programs, events, and community.
* Create engaging admissions and marketing materials for print and digital platforms.
* Gather stories, photographs, testimonials, and other content that showcase student life and the Pilgrim experience.
* Maintain and update enrollment\-related website content and support the school's social media and digital presence.
* Ensure consistent, compelling messaging across enrollment, marketing, and school communications.
* Develop creative outreach strategies to introduce Pilgrim to prospective families and strengthen awareness in the surrounding community.

**Advancement \& Fundraising Support**

* Coordinate communications for annual giving and select fundraising campaigns.
* Ensure gifts are acknowledged promptly and appropriately.
* Assist with fundraising events, sponsorships, donor communications, and other advancement initiatives.
* Support school leadership, volunteers, and the board with donor outreach and stewardship.
* Create marketing and communications materials that support fundraising and community engagement.

**Administration \& Reporting**

* Track enrollment inquiries, applications, conversion, retention, and other key enrollment indicators.
* Provide regular enrollment and marketing reports to school leadership.
* Maintain organized admissions, marketing, and advancement records.
* Recommend improvements to enrollment, communications, and outreach processes.
* Collaborate with the Director of Operations and other members of the administrative team on events and initiatives.

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will have:

* A college degree or equivalent professional experience in enrollment, admissions, marketing, communications, education, nonprofit leadership, or a related field.
* Experience in admissions, enrollment, marketing, communications, customer or family engagement, or a related area.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and a welcoming, service\-oriented approach.
* Creativity and enthusiasm for telling an organization's story and connecting with its community.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
* Proficiency with digital communication tools, social media, databases, spreadsheets, website platforms, and reporting systems.
* Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
* Commitment to the mission, ministry, and values of Pilgrim Lutheran Church \& School.

Experience in fundraising or nonprofit advancement is **helpful but not required**.

**Why This Position Matters**

At Pilgrim, enrollment is about more than filling seats – it is about welcoming families into a community where students are known, supported, challenged, and encouraged to grow.

The Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator will play a key role in helping more families discover Pilgrim, and understand what makes our school unique. Through thoughtful admissions, creative marketing, strong communication, and genuine relationship\-building, this person will help grow our school community and strengthen its future.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys **connecting with people, telling a compelling story, building relationships, and helping an organization grow.**

Pay: $42,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Description:**
The Hearing Care Coordinator (HCC) plays a key role in the success and growth of the Greenfield clinic. Working closely with the Hearing Care Professional and clinical team, the HCC is responsible for creating an exceptional patient experience while helping build awareness, generate new patient opportunities, and grow the clinic within the local community.  

This is a **patient\-focused, sales and business\-growth role**. The HCC builds strong relationships with patients, referring physicians, community partners, and local organizations to generate awareness and grow the clinic. Through proactive outreach, follow\-up, appointment scheduling, and community engagement, the HCC helps connect people with the hearing care they need and supports the clinic in achieving its business goals.  

**As a Hearing Care Coordinator, you will:**
**Patient Engagement \& Sales**
* Create a welcoming, professional, and positive experience for every patient.
* Conduct consistent outbound calls to prospective patients to schedule hearing tests, consultations, and other appointments.
* Support the Hearing Care Professional in achieving clinic goals through strong patient engagement and follow\-up.
* Educate patients on hearing care products, services, accessories, and available solutions.
* Develop strong relationships with patients to encourage retention, referrals, and repeat business.

**Community Outreach \& Business Development**
* Spend approximately **two days per week in the field** conducting community outreach and building awareness of the clinic.
* Build and maintain relationships with physicians, referral sources, community organizations, businesses, senior groups, and other local partners.
* Assist with identifying opportunities to increase awareness of the clinic and generate new patient referrals.
* Represent the clinic in a professional and positive manner at community events, outreach activities, and meetings.
* Take ownership of contributing to the clinic's overall growth and success.

**Clinic \& Patient Support**
* Schedule and confirm patient appointments and manage the clinic's daily schedule effectively.
* Complete insurance benefit verification and authorization requirements.
* Provide first\-level support to patients, answer questions, check patients in and out, and collect and process payments.
* Process patient orders, receive products, verify orders, and coordinate patient pick\-up..
* Perform general office and administrative duties as needed.

**Education:**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate's degree preferred.

**Industry/Product Knowledge:**
* Previous experience in hearing healthcare, hearing aids, or a related healthcare environment is a plus.
* Sales, customer service, business development, or community outreach experience is preferred.

**Skills \& Abilities:**
* Strong sales and relationship\-building skills with the ability to engage patients and build trust.
* Comfortable making daily outbound calls and proactively following up with patients and prospective patients.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with patients, physicians, referral sources, community partners, and clinical staff.
* Self\-motivated, goal\-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of clinic growth initiatives.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Valid driver's license **preferred** and ability to travel locally for community outreach activities.
* Ability to identify opportunities, take initiative, and follow through.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Outlook.
* EMR/EHR experience a plus.

Meta is looking for an experienced Sales Manager to lead a team of account managers focused on growing mid\-market Consumer Packaged Goods and Ecommerce advertisers across Meta's family of apps and services. and is not remote eligible. In this role, you will drive revenue growth by coaching your team to develop consultative advertising strategies, deepen client relationships, and deliver measurable business outcomes for brands navigating the intersection of digital commerce and performance marketing. You will shape how mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce clients leverage Meta's advertising platform to reach consumers, drive conversions, and scale their businesses.  

  

  

### **Sales Manager, Mid\-Market Account Management Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a team of account managers responsible for growing a portfolio of mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce advertisers on Meta's advertising platform
* Define and execute a strategic vision for the mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce segment, identifying growth opportunities and setting team priorities aligned to revenue goals
* Coach account managers on consultative selling techniques, campaign optimization strategies, and stakeholder management across internal partners (cross\-functional teams, specialists, leadership) and external clients
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including marketing, product, measurement, and operations to deliver integrated solutions that address CPG and Ecommerce client needs
* Analyze team and portfolio performance data to identify trends, surface insights, and adjust go\-to\-market strategies for the CPG and Ecommerce vertical
* Represent the mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce segment in cross\-functional planning discussions, contributing to product feedback loops and vertical\-specific initiatives
* Develop and maintain relationships with key mid\-market clients and agency partners to support account growth and retention
* Drive operational excellence across the team by establishing scalable systems, repeatable frameworks, and structured processes for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning
* Filter and prioritize organizational communications to maintain team focus, translating business changes into clear and actionable guidance
* Build and sustain team culture and cohesion across a distributed team, fostering connection through in\-person engagement and deliberate team\-building efforts
* Recruit, onboard, and retain account management talent, building a high\-performing team culture grounded in accountability and client impact

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years of experience in digital advertising sales, account management, or a related client\-facing commercial role
* Experience managing or developing teams in an advertising sales or account management organization, including in an interim lead, pod lead, or similar capacity, within a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment
* Experience building scalable systems and repeatable frameworks to drive team efficiency and consistency
* Experience working with CPG or Ecommerce advertisers on performance marketing, brand campaigns, or digital commerce strategies
* Experience using data and advertising metrics to drive client strategy and team decision\-making, including familiarity with measurement frameworks such as attribution, incrementality, or return on ad spend
* Experience collaborating cross\-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategies

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Ecommerce advertising solutions including catalog\-based advertising, dynamic ads, or conversion optimization products
* Experience managing mid\-market advertiser portfolios at scale within a digital advertising platform environment
* Track record of building and scaling account management processes that improve team efficiency and client outcomes
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with Ecommerce, direct\-to\-consumer, or venture\-backed advertisers in a sales or account management capacity
* Experience leading teams through organizational transitions, restructures, or go\-to\-market changes

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Specialist supports Brown Jordan Inc.'s portfolio of brands (Brown Jordan, Tropitone, Charter, Texacraft, Winston, and Castelle) by managing paid search programs, maintaining website analytics and tracking infrastructure, supporting SEO performance, and producing the data analysis and reporting that inform marketing and executive decision\-making. This is a highly analytical, detail\-oriented role that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple recurring deliverables, vendors, and deadlines across several brands at once.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Own the production of recurring monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc digital marketing performance reports across all brands, including presentation to internal stakeholders.

· Compile and analyze digital marketing metrics to support leadership and executive presentations.

· Pull, consolidate, and analyze performance data for product launches, trade shows, and campaign initiatives, including year\-over\-year comparisons.

· Respond to internal and external requests for historical advertising and marketing metrics, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.

· Build and maintain automated reporting templates and trackers that standardize recurring data pulls across brands.

· Build and maintain dashboards in Looker Studio to visualize performance trends and support self\-serve reporting for stakeholders.

· Create and maintain UTM tracking codes for campaigns across brands to ensure accurate channel attribution in reporting.

· Oversee management of Google Ads campaigns (Google, Microsoft, Meta, Programmatic) across brands, in coordination with the digital marketing agency.

· Monitor campaign performance, pacing, and budgets; identify anomalies and optimization opportunities.

· Coordinate campaign details, creative assets and campaign copy with the internal creative team and external agency partners.

· Manage the digital marketing calendar and campaign performance reporting.

· Produce recurring PPC/paid media performance reports (spend, CTR, CPC, impressions) for stakeholders.

· Participate and present in recurring strategy calls with paid media agency partners and track resulting action items and deliverables.

· Maintain and update Google Analytics (GA4\) configurations, goals, and custom insights across brand websites.

· Implement and manage tags, triggers, and variables in Google Tag Manager to support tracking and campaign measurement needs.

· Monitor site performance (e.g., page speed alerts) and escalate issues to the appropriate team.

· Support website testing and optimization tools (e.g., VWO) as needed.

· Monitor organic search performance and identify opportunities to improve site visibility, rankings, and organic traffic across brand websites.

· Support on\-page SEO (metadata, content structure, internal linking) in coordination with the web and creative teams.

· Conduct keyword research and monitor competitor benchmarks to inform content and campaign strategy.

· Partner with the web team on technical SEO items (site speed, crawlability, structured data) surfaced through audits.

· Produce recurring SEO performance reports (rankings, organic traffic, visibility) for stakeholders.

· Support implementation of AEO/GEO initiatives including online sentiment management and content updates.

· Manage organic social account performance monitoring in Hootsuite, Zoho Social, or similar platforms across brands.

· Track and report on follower growth, engagement rate, and other organic social KPIs on a recurring basis.

· Review, code, and process invoices from digital marketing vendors (Google, agencies, testing platforms).

· Track digital marketing budgets and spend against plan, escalating discrepancies as needed.

· Serve as day\-to\-day point of contact for select vendor relationships.

· Collaborate with brand marketing, creative, and sales teams to gather the inputs needed for reporting and campaigns.

· Support trade show and product launch initiatives with data pulls and performance recaps.

· Manage tasks and deliverables in Asana, ensuring on\-time completion of recurring and ad hoc requests.

**JOB SKILLS REQUIRED**

· Highly analytical, with strong attention to detail and a track record of consistently accurate, on\-time reporting.

· Excellent organizational skills; able to manage multiple recurring deliverables and deadlines across several brands simultaneously.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.
