Runwise is looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to help our rapidly scaling and mission\-driven sales team form even deeper relationships with the biggest names in Real Estate.


**The Team**



Runwise (www.runwise.com) is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused climate\-tech startup that controls and runs the key energy systems (heating, water, etc…) in 8,000\+ buildings throughout the US. Runwise's unique hardware and software service significantly reduces energy usage, substantially lowering costs and carbon output. As of today, Runwise's technology takes the equivalent of 100,000 cars worth of carbon emissions off the road each year.


**The Role**



As a BDR at Runwise, you will own a list of one hundred and fifty of the biggest names in Real Estate. Roughly half of these accounts will be existing customers, while the other half have not yet worked with us. Paired with a Senior Account Executive (who is an expert in the industry) you will be charged with getting Runwise in front of key accounts for portfolio expansion conversations and net new growth opportunities. As the conversations progress, you will support in putting together sales pitches, proposals, and pricing to drive a substantial portion of the company's revenue. BDRs will need to learn industry dynamics, organization structures, and the motivations of each buyer persona. BDRs need to know how to prospect for the right contacts strategically, break into complex organizations, and dynamically tailor the offering to drive decisions.



The right candidate is someone who is goal\-oriented, thinks out of the box, has strong presentation skills, and is highly organized. The right candidate can think a few steps ahead and can connect dots between accounts, contacts, and locations to act relationally. The right candidate can switch between calls, strategy and administrative work in an efficient manner.


**Responsibilities**


* Identify key players, analyze business cases for Runwise, and formulate a pitch
* Leverage a variety of data tools to locate contact information for an account
* Utilize calls, emails, and other creative tactics to connect with accounts
* Partner with a Senior Account Executives to make sure their pipeline continues to grow and deals move swiftly down the funnel
* Generate professional presentations and error free proposals on quick deadlines
* Maintain clean systems and gain proficiency in CRM (Salesforce), automated email tools (Outreach), lead gen tools, city databases, and excel.

**Qualifications**



This position requires an ambitious self\-starter and someone that can effectively connect with Senior level decision makers. Relationship selling skills, with the ability to make a compelling business case, are essential.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative (BDR)**
=============================================

**Location:** Chicago, IL  

**Schedule:** Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in our Chicago office)

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales organization. This person will be on the front lines of our go\-to\-market motion, responsible for generating qualified opportunities for our sales team by engaging CFOs, GCs, Corporate Secretaries, Equity Administrators, and capital\-markets executives at some of the most innovative companies in the world.


You'll be responsible for creating qualified pipeline through thoughtful research, outreach, strong discovery, and clear communication. This is a Chicago\-based role, and candidates must be able to work in our Chicago office at least three days per week.

**Role Requirements**
---------------------

* Intrinsically motivated self\-starter, willing to do whatever it takes to be successful in growing Vinyl Equity
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; you ask precise questions and articulate complex ideas simply
* Ability to manage structured outbound outreach to senior executives (CFO, GC, Corporate Secretary, Equity Admin)
* Build and maintain a healthy top\-of\-funnel pipeline using targeted email, phone, LinkedIn, and industry research
* Comfort operating within a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where processes evolve quickly
* Demonstrated discipline with CRM hygiene, follow\-up, and detailed documentation
* A growth mindset and willingness to iterate, learn, and improve daily
* Ability to collaborate closely with the sales team to support strategic deal cycles
* Represent Vinyl Equity with professionalism and industry fluency in every interaction
* Must be based in Chicago and able to be in\-office 3\+ days per week
* Bachelor's degree

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Prior BDR or other customer\-facing experience
* Familiarity with HubSpot
* Experience selling into financial services, fintech, SaaS, or B2B enterprise accounts
* Exposure to equity management, corporate governance, or capital markets
* Experience at a high\-growth startup

**You could be a great fit if**
-------------------------------

* You communicate with clarity: succinct, direct, and confident with senior audiences
* You enjoy guiding prospects through the early stages of their buying process by identifying pain, impact, and urgency
* You are curious, intellectually engaged, and eager to become an expert in capital markets, equity operations, and compliance workflows
* You take pride in operational excellence, including precise CRM updates, tight follow\-ups, and well\-structured outreach sequences
* You're motivated by fast growth and excited by the pace, autonomy, and opportunity that comes with an early\-stage startup
* You bring persistence and grit, and you are energized by hitting ambitious pipeline goals
* You thrive in environments where creativity and problem\-solving are essential to success
* You're energized by the idea of helping introduce real innovation into an industry that has largely stood still for nearly three decades
* You're comfortable with (and thrive in) ambiguity. This role will be essential in defining how Vinyl goes to market, but will require agency to ensure that we take nothing for granted and leave no stones unturned. There is no concrete playbook for outbound sales in this industry. We're defining it.

**You may not be a great fit if**
---------------------------------

* You dislike prospecting. This role requires consistent outbound sourcing.
* You prefer to leave product knowledge to others. Our expectation is that our entire GTM team will develop deep product and market fluency.
* You resist structured documentation or CRM hygiene.
* You prefer slow\-changing environments or rigid process definitions.
* You are uncomfortable engaging senior executives early in the sales process.
* You prefer to fit into a structured commercial environment with predetermined outbound clarity.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


A few principles that guide how we operate at Vinyl Equity:

* We value high\-agency ownership, first\-principled thinking, thoughtful communication, and a bias toward action
* We believe small, exceptionally talented teams outperform larger teams with average talent
* We aim to demonstrate both product and industry expertise in every interaction with prospects and customers
* Creativity, drive, innovation, and consistency win in otherwise stagnant industries
* Act with high integrity without compromise

**Compensation and Benefits (for U.S.\- based full\-time employees)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Base: $50,000–$75,000
* OTE: $75,000–$95,000 (uncapped commission, paid quarterly)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k
* Flexible PTO
* Hybrid work schedule
* Equity\-based compensation

The Project Coordinator supports the Project Management team by coordinating vendor setup, customer account setup, retail item onboarding, product data management, and the administrative activities required to bring physical consumer products to market.

This role requires prior experience working in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry with physical consumer products sold through retail channels. The ideal candidate has experience supporting products in categories such as beauty, personal care, oral care, wellness, accessories, fashion, or other retail CPG categories.

The Project Coordinator works cross\-functionally with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, Packaging/Creative, and Shipping/Logistics to ensure product information, documentation, samples, item setup, and customer requirements are completed accurately and on time.

This position serves as the department's Vendor \& Item Setup Specialist, while also providing day\-to\-day operational and project coordination support to the Project Management team.

**Responsibilities Product \& Retailer Setup**

* Set up and maintain customer and vendor accounts across retailer, distributor, and customer portals.
* Coordinate new product and item setup requirements for retail customers, distributors, and internal systems.
* Coordinate product information requirements including UPCs, dimensions, case packs, product descriptions, pricing, specifications, packaging information, and other required data.

**Cross\-Functional Product Coordination**

* Work cross\-functionally with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, Packaging/Creative, Operations, and Shipping/Logistics to collect and coordinate information required for product launches.
* Follow up with internal departments to obtain product specifications, regulatory information, packaging details, pricing, UPCs, quality documentation, shipping requirements, and other required launch information.

**Samples, Shipping \& Logistics**

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous professional experience in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry is required.
* Experience working with physical consumer products that are manufactured and sold through retail channels is required.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with multiple departments is required.
* Experience with product/item setup, retail customer requirements, customer portals, vendor onboarding, or product data management is strongly preferred.

* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

**Job Summary**

Fusion Community Empowerment is looking for a high\-energy, organized, and resourceful Administrative \& Program Coordinator who enjoys being part of work that directly impacts the community.

We are a hands\-on nonprofit, which means no two days will look exactly the same. One day you may be coordinating participant appointments and organizing program files, and the next you may be helping prepare for a community event, following up with a partner, updating program data, or making sure the team has what they need to meet an important deadline.

We need someone who is comfortable taking initiative and doesn't need to be reminded of every next step. This person will work closely with the Executive Director and Program Director and will take ownership of many of the administrative details that keep our programs and organization moving.

This is more than answering phones and scheduling meetings. You will help us stay organized, responsive, accountable, and connected to the people we serve.

If you enjoy creating order, following things through to completion, working with different personalities, learning new systems, and being part of a mission\-driven team, you may be a great fit for Fusion.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to the Executive Director, Program Director, and program team.
* Manage calendars, schedule meetings and participant appointments, and help leadership stay ahead of important deadlines and commitments.
* Monitor incoming calls, emails, participant inquiries, and program requests and make sure they reach the appropriate team member.

* Prepare letters, forms, spreadsheets, presentations, reports, sign\-in sheets, and other program materials.
* Assist with community events, workshops, trainings, outreach activities, and partner meetings from planning through follow\-up.
* Communicate professionally and compassionately with participants, community partners, vendors, volunteers, and other stakeholders.
* Assist with staff, intern, and volunteer onboarding and training logistics.
* Help manage office supplies, equipment, purchasing documentation, receipts, invoices, and other routine operational needs.
* Assist with social media, website updates, flyers, newsletters, and program communications when needed.
* Be willing to jump in and help with the small things that keep a nonprofit running. We work as a team, and sometimes that means stepping outside of your regular task list.

**Who We're Looking For**

*We're looking for someone who is:*

* **Proactive.** You don't always wait to be told what comes next.
* **Highly organized.** You can keep track of multiple people, deadlines, documents, and priorities without letting things fall through the cracks.
* **A strong follow\-through person.** Starting a task is important; finishing it is even more important.
* **Comfortable with change.** Nonprofit and community work can move quickly, and priorities sometimes shift.

* **A strong communicator.** You can communicate professionally with leadership, staff, participants, and outside partners.
* **Compassionate with boundaries.** The people we serve may be experiencing housing instability, unemployment, financial hardship, reentry challenges, or other difficult circumstances. You should be able to treat every person with dignity while maintaining professional boundaries and following program procedures.
* **Solution\-oriented.** When something doesn't work, your first instinct is to figure out what the next option is.

**Experience \& Qualifications**

* Previous administrative, program support, office coordination, nonprofit, human services, community\-based, or similar experience preferred.
* Experience working in a nonprofit or community\-based organization is strongly preferred.

The Operations Assistant plays a critical role in maintaining the speed, accuracy, and reliability of day\-to\-day terminal operations. This position exists to ensure freight flows without disruption, operational data remains accurate in real time, and cross\-functional teams are aligned on execution.  

  

In a fast\-moving logistics environment, even small delays or communication gaps can create downstream inefficiencies. This role directly mitigates those risks by owning load visibility, coordinating with multiple internal and external

----------------------------------------------------------

* Track outbound loads daily and ensure system updates are accurate and timely

----------------------------------------------------------

* Manage driver documentation, including IC paperwork, plates, IFTA, and compliance materials

-------------------------------------------------------------

* Trace freight and investigate shipment issues across terminals and agent networks

---------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor functionality of printers and administrative equipment within operations

* Preset appointments for inbound freight and linehaul contractors
* Contribute to team\-based operational goals and continuous improvement efforts

**What you bring**

* High school diploma or GED required; equivalent experience considered

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact across all levels

**How you operate**

* You prioritize accuracy without sacrificing speed
* You take ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks

* You stay organized and focused under operational pressure

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
=========================================

========================================================

FASTSIGNS North Hollywood is looking for an Outside Sales Representative to build our commercial customer base throughout Los Angeles.  

Our work ranges from banners and window graphics to ADA signage, dimensional lettering, channel letters, construction signage, monument signs, and more.  

This is a true business\-development role: finding opportunities, building relationships, developing solutions, and turning them into profitable projects.  

ABOUT US  

FASTSIGNS North Hollywood is a locally owned sign and graphics company. We opened in May 2026 and are building the business from the ground up.  

We are a small, hands\-on team. You will work directly with the owner, design, production, and operations, and see the projects you sell move from initial conversation to installation.  

THE ROLE  

You will own new\-business development for the shop. Prospects may include general contractors, property managers, facility managers, commercial developers, multi\-location businesses, manufacturers, schools, medical groups, and local business owners.  

We provide tools, support, and leads, but you will be expected to actively build relationships and develop a territory.  

What You'll Do:  

* Prospect through phone, email, in\-person outreach, networking, referrals, and industry events
* Meet customers on site, take measurements, and identify signage opportunities
* Develop estimates, bids, and proposals
* Manage your pipeline from first contact through close
* Reactivate dormant accounts and grow existing relationships
* Coordinate with design, production, and operations after the sale

Understand job costs and gross profit so projects are sold profitably  
* 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR  

Required:  

* 2\+ years of outside B2B sales experience, or comparable business sales experience
* Comfortable with cold outreach and starting conversations with new prospects
* Strong follow\-up, organization, and relationship\-building skills
* Able to take basic field measurements and document a job site

Valid California driver's license, reliable transportation, and clean driving record  
* 

Preferred:  

* Sign, print, graphics, construction, building products, or commercial trades experience
* Familiarity with blueprints, permitting, bidding, or estimating
* Experience quoting from costs and margins

Existing relationships with GCs, property managers, facility managers, or commercial businesses in LA  
* 

Sign\-industry experience is helpful but not required. We can teach signage. We want someone who knows how to prospect, follow up, build trust, and close business.  

COMPENSATION  

**Base salary: $40,000–$50,000, depending on experience, plus uncapped commission.**  

**Commission: 10% of gross profit on qualified sales.**  

Gross profit is job revenue minus direct job costs, including materials, outsourced production, subcontracted installation, permits, freight, and other direct project costs. Shop overhead and salaries are not deducted.  

Commission is paid after customer payment is received.  

Qualified sales include new business you source, dormant accounts you reactivate, existing accounts you materially grow, and inbound opportunities over $2,500 that you personally scope, estimate, and close. Routine walk\-in and small repeat orders are handled by other team members.  

BENEFITS

Opportunity to build a territory as the center grows

People who are self\-directed, persistent, comfortable initiating conversations, and good at following through. This is a good fit for someone who would rather build something than inherit it.

MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. About the role
  
  

The Client Partner owns the post\-launch success of a portfolio of NimbleRx pharmacy partners. A positive attitude and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving environment
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Our day\-to\-day work is embodied with a set of core values: **Students First, Be Adaptable,** **Persevere, Take Responsibility, and Commitment to Distinction** or team members who exude these values and a passion for our mission.

**Position Summary**


Under the direction of the Chief Academic Officer or Special Education Designee, the Program Specialist assists and provides administrative support in all matters pertaining to key functions of the Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA), including but not limited to: contract documentation; reconciliation of special education invoices with special education services defined in Individual Education Programs (IEPs); IEP compliance and monitoring; professional development; timely/accurate reporting to the California Department of Education Special Education Division; and managing special education transportation.

**Major duties and responsibilities:**

* Plans programs, provides curricular resources and technical assistance for, and assesses the effectiveness of the program for students with exceptional needs for all Amethod schools
* Ensures the use of best practices in the implementation of pre\-referral behavioral interventions, positive behavioral interventions as outlined in the IEP, and implementation of behavioral support and intervention plans by collaborating with school psychologists, other specialists, or site staff, including providing professional development as needed
* Provides leadership in the area of curriculum, instruction, and modification/accommodation for students with diverse learning needs
* Participates in professional development and provides training and support to the Special Ed Team to enhance instruction for students with social communication, behavioral, and learning challenges
* Assumes responsibility for appropriate identification, educational programming, and services for special education students
* Leverages individual and cultural diversity, demonstrating knowledge and understanding of working with ELL students
* Provides support for data\-driven decision\-making and accountability to improve the instructional program and ensure student progress
* Ensures due process requirements are met to complete the appropriate development of IEPs and provides ongoing monitoring to ensure IDEA compliance
* Participates in evaluation of Ed Specialists and Paraprofessionals and provides support to Principals in the supervision of special education team members.
* Manages complex cases to ensure appropriate special education services, including attending staffing meetings, IEP meetings, and parent conferences
* Applies conflict resolution strategies with parents or other educational partners to resolve disputes related to a student’s IEP, demonstrating knowledge of current IDEA and Amethod policy and procedures
* Assists in the design and facilitation of network\-wide professional development for staff, including onboarding of Special Education team members
* Participate in the designing and redesigning of the Amethod special educational program
* Assists in recruiting and screening of special education staff
* Conduct class observation and speak with teachers to support and monitor all behavioral RTI data
* Support in planning and implementing teacher in\-service and professional development at each school site
* Perform other related duties as required and assigned

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Broad understanding of the MTSS/RTI structure as it relates to school reform
* Ability to use data for decision\-making regarding student needs
* Ability to support professional development in all aspects of intervention methods both academic and behavioral needs
* Ability to work in a high demand environment
* Proven successful teaching or related service experience in Special Education

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Clear CA Education Specialist Credential and CLAD certification required OR CA Related Service Provider Credential/License (School Psychology, Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, etc.)
* CPI certification desired
* Bilingual\- Spanish desired
* Minimum 3 years of related experience in special education leadership

**Compensation**


The salary range for this position is $85,000 \- $105,000\. Salary is commensurate with experience, education, and expertise. A competitive benefits package is also offered. This is a full\-time, exempt, 100% in\-person position.

new_jobs.title: CAP-CT Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program and / or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management and implementation; interprets, monitors and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.


**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments / projects / tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Custom Scope**

The UCSF Division of Geriatrics seeks to recruit a full\-time **Program Coordinator** to support the implementation and operational ownership of a Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) funded program, Caregivers as Partners in Care Teams (CAP\-CT). This position reports to the Program Director and supports/leads a wide\-range of project operations and coordination tasks. The Program Coordinator will perform a broad range of duties that will require analytical, organizational, communication, technical, and coordination skills. Specific duties include: coordinating and maintaining project timelines and deliverables, assisting with researching and applying relevant policies, data collection, management, analyses and reporting, preparing and updating program materials/protocols/procedures, coordinating meeting schedules/agendas/minutes, drafting and updating documents, making program\-related purchases and submitting expense reports, conducting literature searches/reviews, and supporting manuscript preparation/scholarly dissemination. The Program Coordinator will additionally function as a subject matter expert and provide oversight and direction on learning management systems, manage digital education platforms, CE/CME accreditation coordination, analytics reporting, marketing communications, website management, and operational support across multiple projects and conferences. This position requires the ability to be proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of flexibility. An ideal candidate will be able to work independently with minimal supervision, balances multiple competing priorities at any given time, and is intellectually curious, willing to learn new skills and a problem\-solver. The Program Coordinator may be required to provide the same level of support across projects/programs where there is a need.


**Department Overview**

The Division of Geriatrics’ work is grounded in a deep commitment to and respect for older persons from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. We are specialists in aging. Our expertise is in optimizing the health of older individuals. We work in the community and on virtually every UCSF campus – Parnassus, San Francisco VA Health Care System, Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, Mission Bay, and UCSF Center for Geriatric Care. The Division has over 130 employees including faculty, volunteer clinical faculty, fellows, staff, student interns and volunteers. We are deeply committed to, and will champion, diversity, equity and inclusion as our core mission. We will nurture and grow a culture in which everyone from all backgrounds is welcomed, supported, respected, and valued!


  
**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of common organization\- or research\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Proficient in ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Experience in using Qualtrics/REDCap/other surveying platforms.
* Proficient in MS Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.)
* Proficient with Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Learning Management System (LMS).
* Experience working with consumers of educational courses/academic institutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in public health or research administration, e.g. working on state contracts, NIH programs, or working in an academic institution.
* Previous experience using project management tools and software, website management and managing social media platforms.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

new_jobs.description:
Sales Coordinator / Administrative Assistant \- Kitchen Remodeling

**Keane Kitchens \- San Mateo, CA**

**Pay:** $24\-$30 per hour, depending on experience \| **Full\-Time** \| Monday\-Friday  
**Work Location:** In Person \- San Mateo Showroom

**About Keane Kitchens:**

Founded in 1992, Keane Kitchens is a family\-owned Bay Area kitchen remodeling company built on craftsmanship, integrity, attention to detail, and great customer service.

We are looking for an organized, personable, and dependable Sales Coordinator / Administrative Assistant to join our San Mateo showroom and provide dedicated support to one salesperson.

This is an important support role within our sales process. You'll help keep customer appointments, communication, paperwork, estimates, project information, and follow\-ups organized so that customers receive a professional and responsive experience from beginning to end.

**About the Position:**

We're looking for someone who already has experience in an administrative, sales support, project coordination, or similar professional role and is comfortable managing multiple priorities at once.

You do not need previous kitchen or cabinetry experience. We can teach you our products, design process, and how we operate. However, you should already have a strong foundation in organization, customer communication, attention to detail, and follow\-through.

The right person will enjoy staying organized, working with customers, solving small problems before they become bigger ones, and helping keep a busy salesperson and their projects on track.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with one salesperson as their primary administrative and sales support
* Manage and coordinate customer appointments and the salesperson's schedule
* Confirm appointments and help prepare necessary information and materials beforehand
* Keep customer files, paperwork, selections, and project information organized and up to date
* Assist with estimates, proposals, contracts, and other sales documents
* Track outstanding customer information, selections, measurements, decisions, and other project details
* Follow up with customers by phone and email as needed
* Answer incoming phone calls and assist customers professionally
* Help manage routine customer emails and communication
* Assist the salesperson and customers during showroom appointments when needed
* Organize samples, product selections, and presentation materials
* Communicate with customers, vendors, installers, and other team members
* Keep track of open tasks and make sure important items are followed through to completion
* Help maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming showroom
* Learn our products and processes and take on additional responsibilities as you become comfortable in the role

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required:**

* 1\+ year of experience in administrative support, sales support, project coordination, office administration, executive assistance, or a similar professional support role
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Professional and friendly communication skills
* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone, email, and in person
* Experience managing appointments, schedules, paperwork, and follow\-up tasks
* Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and priorities at the same time
* Comfortable using computers, email, calendars, documents, and spreadsheets
* Dependable, punctual, and consistent
* Strong follow\-through and ability to keep track of outstanding tasks
* Proactive and willing to take initiative
* Comfortable working closely with and supporting one salesperson

**Preferred, but not required:**

Experience in kitchen and bath, cabinetry, remodeling, construction, interior design, architecture, home improvement, or another project\-based industry is a strong plus.

**Who Will Do Well in This Role:**

You'll likely be a great fit if you're the type of person who likes keeping things organized and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You notice when something needs to be followed up on, communicate professionally with customers, keep good records, and are comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities.

We're happy to teach you cabinetry, our products, and the Keane Kitchens process. We're looking for someone who already knows how to be organized, dependable, professional, and proactive.

**Why Keane Kitchens?:**

Keane Kitchens has been family\-owned and operated since 1992\. We're a small business where customer relationships, quality work, and attention to detail matter.

You'll work directly alongside an experienced salesperson and become an important part of their day\-to\-day sales operation. You'll learn the kitchen remodeling business, interact directly with customers, and have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as you gain experience.

For the right person, there is an opportunity to grow with the company over time.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

**Pay:** $24\.00\-$30\.00 per hour, depending on experience  
**Expected Hours:** 40 hours per week  
**Schedule:** Monday\-Friday

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

**Work Location:** In person at our San Mateo showroom

Please apply through Indeed with your resume and a brief introduction describing your previous administrative, sales support, or project coordination experience.

Applicants must have at least 1 year of relevant professional experience to be considered.

**Keane Kitchens**  
San Mateo, California  
Family\-Owned \& Operated Since 1992

Pay: $24\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Additional Job Description**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**


 This is an exciting opportunity with CoolIT Systems, the leading provider of scalable liquid cooling technology, as a Key Account Manager (hunter focused) for targeted cloud service provider/Hyperscaler customers. In this role, you will be expected to aggressively identify, pursue, and win strategic opportunities, expand wallet share, and convert high\-value prospects into long\-term customers. Join our rapidly growing organization and make an impact in the data center industry by driving new business growth and accelerating market penetration.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Creator Economy runs on two things creators can't get a straight answer on: what their content is actually earning across platforms, and when that money lands in their account. We're solving both.

Over 1\.2 million Creators across 50\+ countries rely on ChannelMeter for the data behind their business—performance and monetization reporting across platforms beyond YouTube—and for the payments infrastructure that turns that data into money in their bank account. We've processed $1\.8B\+ in payments for Creator Networks, agencies, IP distributors, and global brands, and the analytics layer underneath is just as core to what we do as the payment rails.

The market is heading toward $500B by 2027, and most of the infrastructure to support it—on the data side and the money side—doesn't exist yet. We're building it, and we need someone who can speak fluently to both halves of that problem for every customer who depends on us.

**Why this role exists**

Our customers don't show up with one kind of question. One week it's "why does my YouTube monetization number look off," the next it's "where's my payment," and often it's both at once, tangled together. This isn't a check\-in\-once\-a\-quarter role—you'll be embedded in how our customers understand their own data and their own money, spotting risk before it becomes churn and opportunity before anyone has to ask for it. And you'll do it with AI as a core part of how you work, not an add\-on: Claude, Codex, and Claude Cowork are expected tools here, not optional ones.

**What you'll own**

**Own the full customer relationship**

\- Guide customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, building trust with everyone from day\-to\-day operators to economic buyers

\- Manage a tiered portfolio—hands\-on for our largest Creator Networks and agencies, and scalable playbooks (lifecycle campaigns, in\-product prompts, proactive outreach) for the rest, so growth doesn't just mean more headcount

**Be fluent in the data, not just the money**

\- Help customers interpret their own performance and monetization data—including YouTube monetization trends—as confidently as they'd want a finance person to explain a payment

\- Spot data anomalies (a channel's reported earnings not matching what a customer expects) before they turn into a support escalation or a trust problem

\- Track account health against a mix of signals—retention, expansion, NPS/sentiment, and data/usage patterns—not payment metrics alone

**Turn signals into action**

\- Partner with Risk and Finance on underwriting\-adjacent questions and payment escalations, and with Data and Product on reporting or monetization discrepancies—most real issues touch both

\- Feed what you're hearing from customers back into Product in a structured way, not just as one\-off tickets

**Build the playbook as you go**

\- Use your AI toolkit daily—prep for calls, draft QBRs, summarize account history, and flag risk patterns before they surface

\- Keep a tight, structured pipeline in your task management system—every commitment and renewal date owned, nothing left to memory

\- Help define what great customer success looks like at ChannelMeter as we build out the function

**Who you are**

\- 3–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer\-facing SaaS/B2B role

\- Already fluent with AI tools like Claude, Codex, or Cowork in your daily workflow—this is the single biggest predictor of success here

\- Comfortable being the translator between a data/analytics question and a payments/financial one—most accounts touch both, often in the same conversation

\- A clear, concise writer who simplifies complex things instead of complicating simple ones

\- Obsessively organized, with the kind of follow\-through that catches what everyone else missed

\- Genuinely curious about the Creator Economy—how creators actually make money across platforms, not just how they get paid

**Nice to have**

\- Experience with creator or content analytics, multi\-channel network (MCN) tools, or platform monetization systems (YouTube or otherwise)

\- Experience in payments, fintech, or financial operations

\- Time spent in the Creator Economy—platform, agency, brand, or enterprise side

\- Startup experience where you had to build the process, not just follow one

**The fine print**

\- Based in the SF Bay Area or Los Angeles, available to come into the office regularly

\- Authorized to work in the US—we can't sponsor visas or support relocation for this role

\- Comfortable demonstrating your AI workflow as part of the interview process

**What success looks like**

In your first 60 days: you've met every account in your portfolio and can speak to both the data and the money behind your top accounts accurately, you've got a first pass at a health\-tracking system in place, and your task pipeline is fully stood up.

By 6 months: retention and expansion in your book are trending up, Product and Data are getting structured, regular signal from your accounts, and the playbooks you've built are ones a future hire could pick up and run with.

**Compensation**

\- Base: $55,000–$85,000 USD

\- Commission on top of base—$85K–$125K OTE

\- Health benefits, unlimited PTO, team offsites, and flexible work arrangements

**How we hire**

We move quickly and respect your time. Most candidates wrap up in 2–3 weeks:

1\. Intro call (30 min)

2\. Team interview (45 min)

3\. Short take\-home exercise (AI tools expected, not just encouraged)

4\. Presentation \& discussion

5\. Leadership conversations

6\. References \& offer

**Apply**

Send your resume or LinkedIn to jobs@channelmeter.com. Tell us your favorite Creator, and one specific way you've used data or AI to improve a customer outcome.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Meet the Team
  
  

The Financial Health team helps Cisco plan spending, manage budgets, and use resources effectively. Our work includes budgeting, forecasting, following financial policies, and automating routine tasks. We partner with Finance and Marketing to turn financial data into clear information that supports business decisions. Our team works together to maintain accurate financial records and improve how work gets done. Joining this team gives you the opportunity to help Cisco improve financial planning and support business growth.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

Track operating costs and spending on long\-term assets against approved budgets so budget owners can identify and address differences. Support monthly and quarterly financial reviews by processing purchase requests and invoices, recording costs incurred but not yet billed, and checking that purchasing records match accounting records. Maintain employee count, spending, and forecast data in Hyperion, and explain differences between planned and actual results. Prepare reports that help Finance and Marketing partners understand spending trends, update forecasts, and decide where to take action. Improve recurring financial processes to reduce manual work and errors, with success measured by accurate records, reports delivered on schedule, and completion of required financial checks.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD degree in in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or coursework in finance, accounting, or statistics.
* 3\+ years of experience in business operations, financial analysis, or a role that includes budget tracking and financial reporting.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel to create pivot tables, apply lookup and conditional formulas, and build spreadsheets that calculate spending totals and forecasts.
* Experience completing monthly or quarterly financial reporting activities, including comparing actual spending with budgets, updating forecasts, and checking purchasing records against accounting records.
* Experience preparing financial reports that identify differences between planned and actual spending, explain the causes, and recommend corrective actions.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience using SAP or Oracle to review purchasing and accounting records, and Hyperion to maintain budgets or forecasts.
* Experience building reports or charts in Tableau or Power BI to track spending, budgets, or forecasts.
* Experience using SQL to retrieve and combine data from databases.
* Experience completing a process improvement that reduced processing time, manual steps, or errors, with results that can be described or measured.
* Experience presenting financial findings to colleagues outside Finance and working with them to agree on actions, owners, and deadlines.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.description:
### **About The Role**



Together AI is the AI native cloud, which has been built bottoms up to cater to the demand for the new generation of AI applications and agents. The company has seen tremendous growth with 10X growth year on year and has over a million developers.



As we continue to scale the company, we continue to see strong community engagement \- with developers looking at Together AI not just as an inference platform but also as a go\-to place for all things related to open source AI.This newly created role will lead the charter for community engagement, being the advocate for our technical audience and making sure they get what they need to successful, whether they are current users or prospective customers. They will own our X, LinkedIn and Discord channels, and set the strategy for community engagement and growth. They will work across technical teams internally to develop content and other materials to deliver on that strategy.


### **Responsibilities**


* Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community \- understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
* Operate our community handles across X, Linkedin and Discord
* Own content strategy for these handles, delivering engaging content that the community cares about, across learning content, user content and more
* Collaborate across marketing, developer relations and solution architect teams to deliver on the content strategy
* Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community \- including new content types, competitions and swag
* While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in\-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ Dev\-rel teams

### **Requirements**


* 3\+ years of developer marketing and community engagement experience
* Deep understanding of the AI developer audience
* Keenly aware of social spaces that developers operate in, and ideally, they themselves operate in those spaces on X
* Naturally inclined towards social presence, always keeping a pulse on what’s happening in the developer world
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to build something from ground up
* Data\-driven and ideas person \- always thinking of new experiments and content
* Ideally a developer themselves with an engineering background

### **About Together AI**



Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, reinforcement learning to create specialized models, and pre\-training for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves over 400 trillion tokens a month.


### **Compensation**



We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $200K\-230K \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. This is a hybrid role based in the Bay Area.


### **Equal Opportunity**



Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.



Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative II, U4B Health
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

Uber Health is one of the fastest\-growing segments within Uber for Business. We are looking for an Inbound Sales Development Representative who thrives in a high\-velocity, detail\-oriented environment. This role focuses exclusively on inbound lead qualification, with a core emphasis on speed, precision, and value\-based discovery.  

  

**What You'll Do:**  

* Rapidly qualify and route inbound leads from marketing, customer support, and direct inquiries.
* Consistently meet or exceed MQL \& SLA targets by responding to leads with urgency and a focus on quality.
* Use Salesforce, internal data platforms, and AI tools to triage and prioritize lead queues.
* Own the discovery and qualification process using the B.A.N.T. framework to ensure a smooth handoff to closing teams.
* Maintain clean and up\-to\-date pipeline hygiene \- no lead left behind.
* Identify patterns and share insights from inbound volume to help refine targeting and improve the funnel.
* Participate in light travel to health conferences and industry events to support lead generation and deepen market understanding.

  

**Basic Qualifications:*** 1\+ year of experience in a sales, customer success, or lead qualification role \- preferably in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and close attention to detail
* Proficient in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and comfortable navigating multiple channels with speed and precision

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience managing and organizing inbound leads in Salesforce, with the ability to create reports and leverage internal tools for lead routing and prioritization.
* Background in healthcare or experience speaking with healthcare providers, payers, or organizations is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-driven revenue models (e.g., rides completed or booked services).
* Proven track record of high performance \- consistently top\-ranked or known for exceeding expectations, with a clear explanation of how you achieved success.

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The total annualized on\-target earnings (OTE) for this position is USD $81,120 \- USD $85,429\. The OTE includes a base hourly rate of USD $27\.30 per hour \- USD $28\.75 per hour and an annualized cash variable incentive target range of USD $24,336 \- USD $25,629\.  

  

For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The total annualized on\-target earnings (OTE) for this position is USD $81,120 \- USD $85,429\. The OTE includes a base hourly rate of USD $27\.30 per hour \- USD $28\.75 per hour and an annualized cash variable incentive target range of USD $24,336 \- USD $25,629\.  

  

The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance and its payment is based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan.  

  

An equity award and other forms of compensation may be included in the offer. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

CrowdStrike is looking for an Executive Assistant to support three VP\-level leaders across our global Engineering organization. **Operational Support and Partnership**

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with consistent discretion and sound judgment

**What You'll Need:**

* 2\+ years of executive administrative support experience, including direct support of senior leaders (Director level or above), or equivalent combination of experience and education
* Demonstrated experience booking and managing complex domestic and international travel, including multi\-leg itineraries, visa and documentation requirements, and real\-time rebooking during disruptions
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, high\-volume calendars across multiple time zones for multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with Google Workspace — Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive — is required
* Proficiency with Zoom and Slack is required
* Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in your workflow — for example, drafting and editing communications, summarizing meetings and documents, researching travel and logistics, or preparing briefing materials — and enthusiasm for adopting new AI tooling as it becomes available
* Experience acting as an approval delegate for travel and expense workflows, with working knowledge of T\&E policy
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
* Exceptional attention to detail — reviews all relevant information before acting and proactively seeks review of your own work
* Proven ability to plan and coordinate group events and meetings independently
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and proprietary information
* Ability to work onsite in Sunnyvale, CA or Redmond, WA on a hybrid schedule
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically with advance notice to support leader

**Job Summary**


The Program Coordinator, Enhanced Surveillance (Program Coordinator) plans, organizes, coordinates, and conducts Enhanced Surveillance activities, including syndromic surveillance, wastewater surveillance, surveillance for diseases of seasonal importance (including respiratory diseases and endemic vector\-borne disease), and other enhanced or non\-traditional surveillance activities. Supervises program staff in all areas of Enhanced Surveillance. The Program Coordinator is responsible for generating surveillance reports to inform the prevalence and distribution of diseases routinely and during outbreaks. Participates in outbreak and control activities. Provides training and establishes strategic priorities in the areas of syndromic, wastewater, and seasonal surveillance, as well as other non\-traditional surveillance data sources.

**Typical Duties**

* Monitors data in non\-traditional surveillance systems (e.g., syndromic, wastewater) and develops reports and dashboards to report on findings.
* Develops and validates methods and procedures for non\-traditional surveillance.
* Monitors data quality in non\-traditional surveillance systems and works with partners to improve completeness and accuracy.
* Oversees and directs enhanced surveillance for seasonal diseases including respiratory illness (e.g., influenza, COVID\-19, and RSV) and West Nile Virus.
* Assists with immunization data analysis and reporting, particularly for respiratory immunizations.
* Keeps the Director fully informed of pertinent information and follows through on assignments.
* Explores and develops methods for communicable disease forecasting and modeling.
* Analyzes and interprets data to identify epidemic trends and makes recommendations for strategies related to policy development, prevention, and program planning.
* Supports informatics and data modernization initiatives, such as electronic case reporting.
* Identifies new data sources for enhanced surveillance.
* Maintains an enhanced surveillance procedure manual.
* Collaborates with local, state, and federal partners in enhanced surveillance initiatives, including participation in relevant communities of practice.
* Supports quality improvement projects.
* Participates and represents the agency at specified meetings and responds to inquiries from the public, media and health care professionals.
* Available for on\-call duties.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, or related Public Health concentration.
* Five (5\) years of experience in disease surveillance and control or epidemiologic data analysis.
* Two (2\) years of supervisory and/or managerial experience in relevant public health programs
* Proficient in R, SAS, or Python
* Proficient using Microsoft Office

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in communicable disease investigation.
* Advanced knowledge of statistical methods

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics**

* Working knowledge of communicable disease regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of theories, principles and practice of epidemiology and biostatistics in the field of public health
* Proficiency in the use of electronic databases and statistical software programs used for epidemiological analysis
* Proficiency in the use of computer software used for mapping
* Excellent verbal, written communication, and interpersonal skills necessary to communicate with all levels of staff and a patient population composed of diverse cultures and age groups
* Skill in planning, developing and completing complex assignments with minimal direction.
* Accurate judgment in making decisions and in meeting new problems
* Ability to work independently Ability to accurately and effectively respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the public health community
* Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors
* Ability to make sound discretionary decisions
* Ability to work well under pressure
* Ability to represent CCDPH with tact and diplomacy
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team

**Physical and Environmental Demands**


This position is functioning within a healthcare environment. The incumbent is responsible for adherence to all hospital and department specific safety requirements. This includes but is not limited to the following policies and procedures: complying with Personal Protective Equipment requirements, hand washing and sanitizing practices, complying with department specific engineering and work practice controls and any other work area safety precautions as specified by hospital wide policy and departmental procedures.

new_jobs.description:
Meta is looking for an experienced Sales Manager to lead a team of account managers focused on growing mid\-market Consumer Packaged Goods and Ecommerce advertisers across Meta's family of apps and services. and is not remote eligible. In this role, you will drive revenue growth by coaching your team to develop consultative advertising strategies, deepen client relationships, and deliver measurable business outcomes for brands navigating the intersection of digital commerce and performance marketing. You will shape how mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce clients leverage Meta's advertising platform to reach consumers, drive conversions, and scale their businesses.  

  

  

### **Sales Manager, Mid\-Market Account Management Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a team of account managers responsible for growing a portfolio of mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce advertisers on Meta's advertising platform
* Define and execute a strategic vision for the mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce segment, identifying growth opportunities and setting team priorities aligned to revenue goals
* Coach account managers on consultative selling techniques, campaign optimization strategies, and stakeholder management across internal partners (cross\-functional teams, specialists, leadership) and external clients
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including marketing, product, measurement, and operations to deliver integrated solutions that address CPG and Ecommerce client needs
* Analyze team and portfolio performance data to identify trends, surface insights, and adjust go\-to\-market strategies for the CPG and Ecommerce vertical
* Represent the mid\-market CPG and Ecommerce segment in cross\-functional planning discussions, contributing to product feedback loops and vertical\-specific initiatives
* Develop and maintain relationships with key mid\-market clients and agency partners to support account growth and retention
* Drive operational excellence across the team by establishing scalable systems, repeatable frameworks, and structured processes for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning
* Filter and prioritize organizational communications to maintain team focus, translating business changes into clear and actionable guidance
* Build and sustain team culture and cohesion across a distributed team, fostering connection through in\-person engagement and deliberate team\-building efforts
* Recruit, onboard, and retain account management talent, building a high\-performing team culture grounded in accountability and client impact

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years of experience in digital advertising sales, account management, or a related client\-facing commercial role
* Experience managing or developing teams in an advertising sales or account management organization, including in an interim lead, pod lead, or similar capacity, within a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment
* Experience building scalable systems and repeatable frameworks to drive team efficiency and consistency
* Experience working with CPG or Ecommerce advertisers on performance marketing, brand campaigns, or digital commerce strategies
* Experience using data and advertising metrics to drive client strategy and team decision\-making, including familiarity with measurement frameworks such as attribution, incrementality, or return on ad spend
* Experience collaborating cross\-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategies

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Ecommerce advertising solutions including catalog\-based advertising, dynamic ads, or conversion optimization products
* Experience managing mid\-market advertiser portfolios at scale within a digital advertising platform environment
* Track record of building and scaling account management processes that improve team efficiency and client outcomes
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with Ecommerce, direct\-to\-consumer, or venture\-backed advertisers in a sales or account management capacity
* Experience leading teams through organizational transitions, restructures, or go\-to\-market changes

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. The Digital Marketing Specialist supports Brown Jordan Inc.'s portfolio of brands (Brown Jordan, Tropitone, Charter, Texacraft, Winston, and Castelle) by managing paid search programs, maintaining website analytics and tracking infrastructure, supporting SEO performance, and producing the data analysis and reporting that inform marketing and executive decision\-making. · Own the production of recurring monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc digital marketing performance reports across all brands, including presentation to internal stakeholders.

· Compile and analyze digital marketing metrics to support leadership and executive presentations.

· Pull, consolidate, and analyze performance data for product launches, trade shows, and campaign initiatives, including year\-over\-year comparisons.

· Respond to internal and external requests for historical advertising and marketing metrics, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.

· Build and maintain automated reporting templates and trackers that standardize recurring data pulls across brands.

· Monitor campaign performance, pacing, and budgets; identify anomalies and optimization opportunities.

· Coordinate campaign details, creative assets and campaign copy with the internal creative team and external agency partners.

· Implement and manage tags, triggers, and variables in Google Tag Manager to support tracking and campaign measurement needs.

· Monitor site performance (e.g., page speed alerts) and escalate issues to the appropriate team.

· Support website testing and optimization tools (e.g., VWO) as needed.

· Monitor organic search performance and identify opportunities to improve site visibility, rankings, and organic traffic across brand websites.

· Support on\-page SEO (metadata, content structure, internal linking) in coordination with the web and creative teams.

· Conduct keyword research and monitor competitor benchmarks to inform content and campaign strategy.

· Partner with the web team on technical SEO items (site speed, crawlability, structured data) surfaced through audits.

· Produce recurring SEO performance reports (rankings, organic traffic, visibility) for stakeholders.

· Support implementation of AEO/GEO initiatives including online sentiment management and content updates.

· Manage organic social account performance monitoring in Hootsuite, Zoho Social, or similar platforms across brands.

· Track and report on follower growth, engagement rate, and other organic social KPIs on a recurring basis.

· Review, code, and process invoices from digital marketing vendors (Google, agencies, testing platforms).

· Track digital marketing budgets and spend against plan, escalating discrepancies as needed.

· Serve as day\-to\-day point of contact for select vendor relationships.

· Collaborate with brand marketing, creative, and sales teams to gather the inputs needed for reporting and campaigns.

· Support trade show and product launch initiatives with data pulls and performance recaps.

· Manage tasks and deliverables in Asana, ensuring on\-time completion of recurring and ad hoc requests.

**JOB SKILLS REQUIRED**

· Excellent organizational skills; able to manage multiple recurring deliverables and deadlines across several brands simultaneously.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

· Working knowledge of SEO best practices and tools (e.g., Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs).

· Experience managing organic social reporting in Hootsuite, Zoho Social, or similar platforms.

· Experience building UTM tracking codes to support accurate campaign attribution.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

· Experience with Ai tools and building reporting automations.
